verses.1:1: Now it happened in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was in the midst of the exiles by the Chebar River, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.1:2: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
verses.1:3: the word of the LORD indeed came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the Chebar River, and the hand of the LORD came upon him there.
verses.1:4: And I looked, and look, a tempestuous wind was coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flaring back and forth and brightness all around it; and from its midst was something like the gleam of electrum, from the midst of the fire.
verses.1:5: And from its midst came the likeness of four living creatures. Now this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.
verses.1:6: Each one had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
verses.1:7: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a calf's foot, and they sparkled like the gleam of burnished bronze.
verses.1:8: Human hands were under their wings on their four sides, and the four of them had their faces and their wings.
verses.1:9: Their wings were joined one to another. They did not turn as they went; each one went in the direction it faced.
verses.1:10: And the likeness of their faces was the face of a man; and the four of them had the face of a lion on the right side, and the four of them had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four of them had the face of an eagle.
verses.1:11: And their faces and their wings were spread apart above: each had two that joined another, and two that covered their bodies.
verses.1:12: And each one went in the direction it faced; wherever the spirit was to go, they went; they did not turn as they went.
verses.1:13: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches; it was moving back and forth among the living creatures, and the fire had brightness, and lightning was coming out from the fire.
verses.1:15: And I looked at the living creatures, and look, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for its four faces.
verses.1:16: The appearance of the wheels and their construction was like the gleam of beryl, and the four of them had one likeness; and their appearance and their construction were as if a wheel were inside a wheel.
verses.1:17: Toward any of their four sides they would go as they went; they did not turn as they went.
verses.1:18: As for their rims, they were high and awe-inspiring, and their rims were full of eyes all around on the four of them.
verses.1:19: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.1:20: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went, there where the spirit was to go; and the wheels were lifted up alongside them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.1:21: When those went, these went; and when those stood still, these stood still; and when they were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up alongside them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.1:22: And over the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an expanse, like the gleam of awesome crystal, stretched out over their heads above.
verses.1:23: And under the expanse their wings were straight, one toward another; each had two covering them, and each had two covering their bodies.
verses.1:24: And I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, when they went—a sound of tumult like the sound of an army; when they stood still, they lowered their wings.
verses.1:25: And a voice came from above the expanse that was over their heads; when they stood still, they lowered their wings.
verses.1:26: And above the expanse that was over their heads was something like the appearance of a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness with the appearance of a man, above upon it.
verses.1:27: And I saw something like the gleam of electrum, like the appearance of fire enclosed within it all around, from the appearance of His waist and upward; and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw something like the appearance of fire, and there was brightness all around Him.
verses.1:28: Like the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud on a day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. That was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And I saw it, and I fell on my face, and I heard a voice speaking.
verses.2:1: Then He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, so that I may speak with you."
verses.2:2: And a spirit came into me as He spoke to me, and stood me on my feet; and I heard the One speaking to me.
verses.2:3: Then He said to me, "Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to rebellious nations who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
verses.2:4: And the children are defiant of face and hard of heart; I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says.'
verses.2:5: And as for them, whether they listen or refrain—for they are a house of rebellion—they will know that a prophet has been in their midst.
verses.2:6: And you, son of man, do not fear them, and do not fear their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you sit among scorpions. Do not fear their words and do not be dismayed at their presence, for they are a house of rebellion.
verses.2:7: And you shall speak My words to them, whether they listen or refrain, for they are rebellious.
verses.2:8: And you, son of man, listen to what I am speaking to you; do not be rebellious like the house of rebellion. Open your mouth wide and eat what I am giving you."
verses.2:9: Then I looked, and see, a hand was extended toward me; and look, in it was a written scroll.
verses.2:10: And He spread it out before me, and it was written on front and back; and written on it were laments, and groaning, and woe.
verses.3:1: And He said to me, "Son of man, what you find, eat—eat this scroll, and go speak to the house of Israel."
verses.3:2: And I opened my mouth, and He made me eat this scroll.
verses.3:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, feed your stomach and fill your inward parts with this scroll that I am giving you." So I ate it, and it was in my mouth like honey for sweetness.
verses.3:4: Then He said to me, "Son of man, go, go in to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them.
verses.3:5: For you are not being sent to a people deep of speech and heavy of tongue, but to the house of Israel—
verses.3:6: not to many peoples deep of speech and heavy of tongue, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
verses.3:7: Yet the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, because they are not willing to listen to Me; for all the house of Israel are hard of forehead and stubborn of heart.
verses.3:8: Look, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
verses.3:9: Like diamond, harder than flint, I have made your forehead. Do not fear them, and do not be dismayed at their presence, for they are a house of rebellion."
verses.3:10: And He said to me, "Son of man, all My words that I will speak to you, take into your heart and hear with your ears.
verses.3:11: And go, go in to the exiles, to the sons of your people, and speak to them and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' whether they listen or refrain."
verses.3:12: Then a spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the sound of a great rumbling: "Blessed be the glory of the LORD from His place!"
verses.3:13: And there was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing one against another, and the sound of the wheels alongside them, and the sound of a great rumbling.
verses.3:14: So a spirit lifted me up and took me away; and I went bitter in the fury of my spirit, while the hand of the LORD pressed hard upon me.
verses.3:15: Then I came to the exiles at Tel Abib, who were dwelling by the Chebar River, and I dwelt where they were dwelling; and I sat there seven days, stunned, in their midst.
verses.3:16: And it happened at the end of seven days that the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.3:17: "Son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel; and you shall hear a word from My mouth and warn them from Me.
verses.3:18: When I say to the wicked man, 'You shall surely die,' and you do not warn him and do not speak to warn the wicked man from his wicked way to keep him alive, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:19: Yet if you warn the wicked man, and he does not turn from his wickedness and from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your life.
verses.3:20: And when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, and I place a stumbling block before him, he shall die; because you did not warn him, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds that he has done shall not be remembered, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:21: Yet if you warn the righteous man that the righteous man should not sin, and he does not sin, he shall surely live because he took warning, and you have delivered your life."
verses.3:22: And the hand of the LORD came upon me there, and He said to me, "Get up, go out to the valley, and I will speak with you there."
verses.3:23: So I got up and went out to the valley, and look, the glory of the LORD was standing there, like the glory that I had seen by the Chebar River, and I fell on my face.
verses.3:24: Then a spirit came into me and stood me on my feet, and He spoke with me and said to me, "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.3:25: And as for you, son of man, look, they will put cords on you and bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.
verses.3:26: And I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, and you will become mute and will not be to them a man who reproves, for they are a house of rebellion.
verses.3:27: Yet when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Let the one who listens listen, and let the one who refrains refrain,' for they are a house of rebellion."
verses.4:1: "Now you, son of man, take for yourself a brick, set it in front of you, and inscribe on it a city, Jerusalem.
verses.4:2: Lay siege against it, build a siege wall against it, heap up a siege ramp against it, set camps against it, and position battering rams against it all around.
verses.4:3: And you, take for yourself an iron griddle and set it as an iron wall between you and the city, and direct your face toward it; it shall be under siege, and you shall besiege it. It is a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.4:4: And you, lie down on your left side and put the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it. For the number of days that you lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
verses.4:5: And I have appointed for you the years of their iniquity as a number of days, three hundred and ninety days; so you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.4:6: When you have finished these, you shall lie down on your right side a second time and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah for forty days; a day for each year, a day for each year I have appointed it for you.
verses.4:7: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you shall direct your face, with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
verses.4:8: Now look, I have placed cords upon you, so that you will not turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege.
verses.4:9: And you, take for yourself wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and place them in one vessel and make them into bread for yourself. For the number of days that you lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat it.
verses.4:10: And the food that you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from set time to set time you shall eat it.
verses.4:11: And water you shall drink by measure, a sixth of a hin; from set time to set time you shall drink.
verses.4:12: And as a barley cake you shall eat it; you shall bake it on dung of human excrement before their eyes."
verses.4:13: Then the LORD said, "In this way the sons of Israel will eat their bread unclean among the nations to which I will drive them."
verses.4:14: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Look, my soul has not been defiled; from my youth until now I have not eaten an animal that died naturally or was torn by beasts, nor has foul meat entered my mouth."
verses.4:15: Then He said to me, "See, I have given you cattle dung in place of human dung, and you shall make your bread over it."
verses.4:16: And He said to me, "Son of man, look, I am breaking the staff of bread in Jerusalem; they will eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and they will drink water by measure and in horror,
verses.4:17: so that they will lack bread and water, and be horrified, each man and his brother, and waste away in their iniquity."
verses.5:1: "Now you, son of man, take for yourself a sharp sword; as a barber's razor you shall take it for yourself and pass it over your head and over your beard. Then take for yourself weighing scales and divide the hair.
verses.5:2: A third you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city when the days of the siege are fulfilled. And you shall take a third and strike it with the sword all around it, and a third you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.5:3: And you shall take from there a few in number and tie them in the corners of your garment.
verses.5:4: And from these you shall take some again, throw them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire; from it fire will go out to the whole house of Israel."
verses.5:5: This is what the Lord GOD says, "This is Jerusalem; I have placed her in the midst of the nations, with lands all around her.
verses.5:6: Yet she has rebelled against My ordinances in wickedness beyond the nations, and against My statutes beyond the lands around her; for My ordinances they have rejected, and in My statutes they have not walked."
verses.5:7: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says, "Because your tumult is greater than that of the nations around you, and you have not walked in My statutes, nor carried out My ordinances, nor acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you—"
verses.5:8: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says, "Look, I Myself also am against you, and I will carry out judgments in your midst before the eyes of the nations.
verses.5:9: And I will do among you what I have not done, and anything like it I will never do again, because of all your abominations.
verses.5:10: Therefore fathers will eat sons in your midst, and sons will eat their fathers; and I will carry out judgments upon you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.
verses.5:11: Therefore, as I live," declares the Lord GOD, "indeed, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your loathsome things and with all your abominations, I too will withdraw, and My eye will not look with pity, and I too will have no compassion.
verses.5:12: A third of you will die by plague and perish by famine in your midst; a third will fall by the sword all around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.5:13: And My anger will come to an end, and I will let My wrath rest upon them and find relief; and they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in My zeal when I bring My wrath to an end on them.
verses.5:14: And I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations that are around you, before the eyes of every passerby.
verses.5:15: And she will become a reproach and a taunt, an admonition and a horror, to the nations that are around you, when I carry out judgments upon you in anger and in wrath and in rebukes of wrath. I, the LORD, have spoken.
verses.5:16: When I send the evil arrows of famine against them, which are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, then I will increase famine upon you and break for you the staff of bread.
verses.5:17: And I will send famine and vicious beasts upon you, and they will bereave you; plague and bloodshed will pass through you, and I will bring a sword upon you. I, the LORD, have spoken."
verses.6:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.6:2: "Son of man, turn your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
verses.6:3: and say, 'Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys: "Look, I Myself am bringing a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.6:4: And your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be shattered, and I will throw down those of you who are killed before your idols.
verses.6:5: And I will place the corpses of the sons of Israel in front of their idols, and scatter your bones all around your altars.
verses.6:6: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will become desolate, so that your altars will be laid waste and bear guilt, your idols will be shattered and come to an end, your incense altars will be hewn down, and your works will be wiped away.
verses.6:7: And those killed will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.6:8: Yet I will leave some remaining, in that you will have survivors of the sword among the nations when you are scattered through the lands.
verses.6:9: Then your survivors will remember Me among the nations where they were taken captive, how I have been broken by their heart that prostituted itself, which departed from Me, and by their eyes that prostituted themselves after their idols; and they will be disgusted with themselves in their own sight because of the evil things they have done, for all their abominations.
verses.6:10: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not speak in vain about bringing this calamity upon them."'"
verses.6:11: This is what the Lord GOD says, "Strike with your hand and stomp with your foot, and say, 'Alas!' over all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel; for by the sword, by famine, and by plague they will fall.
verses.6:12: The one who is far away will die by plague, and the one who is near will fall by the sword, and the one who remains and is besieged will die by famine; and I will bring My wrath to an end upon them.
verses.6:13: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when those of them who are killed lie in the midst of their idols, all around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every lush tree, and under every thick-branched terebinth, the place where they presented a soothing fragrance to all their idols.
verses.6:14: And I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land a desolation and a wasteland, from the wilderness to Diblah, in all their dwelling places; and they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.7:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.7:2: "And you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the soil of Israel: 'An end! The end has come upon the four edges of the land.
verses.7:3: An end has come; the end has come! It has awakened against you; look, it is coming!
verses.7:4: The doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come, the day is near—tumult, and not joyful shouting of the mountains.
verses.7:5: Now shortly I will pour out My fury upon you, and exhaust My anger against you, and judge you according to your ways, and lay all your abominations upon you.
verses.7:6: And My eye will not spare, nor will I have compassion; according to your ways I will repay you, and your abominations will be in your midst; and you will know that I, the LORD, am the one who strikes.
verses.7:7: Now the end is upon you, and I will send My anger against you, and judge you according to your ways, and lay all your abominations upon you.
verses.7:8: And My eye will not spare you, nor will I have compassion; for I will lay your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst; and you will know that I am the LORD.'
verses.7:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: 'Disaster, a singular disaster! Look, it is coming! Look, the day! Look, it is coming! The doom has gone out; the rod has bloomed, arrogance has sprouted.
verses.7:11: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness; none of them, none of their multitude, none of their abundance, nor any eminence among them.
verses.7:12: The time has come, the day has arrived; let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn, for burning anger is upon all her multitude.
verses.7:13: For the seller will not return to what was sold, even while their life is still among the living; for the vision against all her multitude will not turn back, and in his iniquity none of them will sustain his life.
verses.7:14: They have sounded the horn and prepared everything, yet no one is going to the battle, for My burning anger is upon all her multitude.
verses.7:15: The sword is outside, and the plague and the famine are inside; the one who is in the field will die by the sword, and the one who is in the city—famine and plague will devour him.
verses.7:16: And their survivors will escape and be upon the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them groaning, each man because of his iniquity.
verses.7:17: All hands will go limp, and all knees will run with water.
verses.7:18: And they will wrap themselves in sackcloth, and shuddering will cover them; on every face will be shame, and on all their heads baldness.
verses.7:19: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an impure thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to rescue them on the day of the wrath of the LORD. They will not satisfy their appetite, nor will they fill their stomachs, for it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
verses.7:20: And as for the beauty of its ornament, they turned it into pride, and the images of their abominations—their detestable things—they made with it; therefore I have made it an impure thing to them.
verses.7:21: And I will give it into the hand of the foreigners for plunder, and to the wicked of the earth for spoil, and they will profane it.
verses.7:22: And I will turn My face away from them, and they will profane My hidden place; and violent men will come into it and profane it.
verses.7:23: Make the chain, for the land is filled with crimes of bloodshed, and the city is filled with violence.
verses.7:24: And I will bring the most wicked of nations, and they will take possession of their houses; I will end the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be profaned.
verses.7:25: Anguish has come, and they will seek peace, yet there will be none.
verses.7:26: Calamity upon calamity will come, and there will be report upon report; they will seek a vision from a prophet, yet instruction will perish from a priest, and counsel from elders.
verses.7:27: The king will mourn, and a prince will clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will shake with terror. According to their way I will deal with them, and by their own judgments I will judge them; and they will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.8:1: Now it happened in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me there.
verses.8:2: Then I looked, and look, a likeness like the appearance of fire: from the appearance of His waist and downward was fire, and from His waist and upward was like the appearance of radiance, like the sheen of glowing metal.
verses.8:3: And He stretched out the form of a hand and took hold of me by a lock of my head; and a spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heavens and brought me to Jerusalem in visions of God, to the entrance of the inner gate that faces toward the north, where the seat of the statue of jealousy was, which provokes to jealousy.
verses.8:4: And look, there was the glory of the God of Israel, like the appearance that I had seen in the plain.
verses.8:5: Then He said to me, "Son of man, lift your eyes now northward." So I lifted my eyes northward, and look, to the north of the gate of the altar was this statue of jealousy in the entryway.
verses.8:6: And He said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is doing here, so that I should go far away from My sanctuary? Yet again you will see great abominations."
verses.8:7: Then He brought me to the entrance of the courtyard; and I looked, and look, there was a hole in the wall.
verses.8:8: And He said to me, "Son of man, dig through the wall now." So I dug through the wall, and look, an entrance!
verses.8:9: And He said to me, "Go in and see the evil abominations that they are doing here."
verses.8:10: So I went in and looked, and look, every form of creeping creature and detestable beast, and all the idols of the house of Israel, was carved upon the wall all the way around.
verses.8:11: And seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel—with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan standing in their midst—were standing before them, each man with his censer in his hand, and the aroma of the cloud of incense was ascending.
verses.8:12: Then He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each man in the chambers of his carved image? For they say, 'The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.'"
verses.8:13: And He said to me, "Yet again you will see great abominations that they are doing."
verses.8:14: Then He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the house of the LORD that is toward the north, and look, women were sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
verses.8:15: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? Yet again you will see abominations greater than these."
verses.8:16: Then He brought me into the inner courtyard of the house of the LORD; and look, at the entrance of the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces eastward, and they were bowing down eastward to the sun.
verses.8:17: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? Is it too light a thing for the house of Judah to do the abominations that they have done here, that they have filled the land with violence and have provoked Me to anger yet again? And look, they are extending the branch to their nose!
verses.8:18: And I too will act in fury; My eye will not spare, nor will I have compassion. And they will cry out in My ears with a loud voice, yet I will not listen to them."
verses.9:1: Then He cried out in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "The appointed executioners of the city have drawn near, each man with his weapon of destruction in his hand."
verses.9:2: And look, six men were coming from the direction of the upper gate that is turned northward, each man with his smashing weapon in his hand; and one man in their midst was clothed in linen, with a scribe's writing kit at his waist. And they came in and stood beside the altar of bronze.
verses.9:3: Now the glory of the God of Israel rose up from above the cherub on which it had been to the threshold of the house; and He called to the man clothed in linen who had the scribe's writing kit at his waist.
verses.9:4: And the LORD said to him, "Pass through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men who are sighing and groaning over all the abominations that are being done in its midst."
verses.9:5: And to these He said in my hearing, "Pass through the city after him and strike; do not let your eye spare, and do not have compassion.
verses.9:6: Kill to destruction old men, young men and virgins, little children and women, but do not come near any man on whom is the mark; and begin from My sanctuary." So they began with the elder men who were in front of the house.
verses.9:7: And He said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the courtyards with the dead. Go out!" So they went out and struck throughout the city.
verses.9:8: And it happened as they were striking, and I was left behind, that I fell upon my face and cried out and said, "Alas, Lord GOD! Are You destroying all the remnant of Israel as You pour out Your fury upon Jerusalem?"
verses.9:9: Then He said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is great in the extreme; the land has been filled with bloodshed, and the city is full of injustice; for they have said, 'The LORD has forsaken the land, and the LORD does not see.'
verses.9:10: And as for Me too, My eye will not spare, nor will I have compassion; I have laid their way upon their heads."
verses.9:11: And look, the man clothed in linen, who had the writing kit at his waist, brought back word, saying, "I have done according to all that You commanded me."
verses.10:1: Then I looked, and look, upon the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim, something like a sapphire stone, like the appearance of the likeness of a throne, was seen above them.
verses.10:2: And He spoke to the man clothed in linen and said, "Go in among the wheelwork, underneath the cherub, and fill your cupped hands with coals of fire from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." So he went in before my eyes.
verses.10:3: Now the cherubim were standing on the right side of the house when the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner courtyard.
verses.10:4: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherub to the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was full of the radiance of the glory of the LORD.
verses.10:5: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard all the way to the outer courtyard, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
verses.10:6: Now it happened, when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, "Take fire from among the wheelwork, from among the cherubim," that he went in and stood beside the wheel.
verses.10:7: Then the cherub stretched out his hand from among the cherubim toward the fire that was among the cherubim, lifted some up, and placed it into the cupped hands of the one clothed in linen, and he took it and went out.
verses.10:8: And there appeared on the cherubim the form of a human hand underneath their wings.
verses.10:9: Then I looked, and look, four wheels beside the cherubim—one wheel beside one cherub and another wheel beside another cherub—and the appearance of the wheels was like the gleam of a beryl stone.
verses.10:10: As for their appearance, all four of them shared one likeness, as though a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.10:11: When they moved, they would move toward any of their four sides; they did not turn as they moved, for to the place where the head faced, they followed after it; they did not turn as they moved.
verses.10:12: And their whole body, their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around—the wheels belonging to all four of them.
verses.10:13: As for the wheels, they were called "the wheelwork" in my hearing.
verses.10:15: Then the cherubim rose up. This was the living creature that I had seen at the Chebar River.
verses.10:16: When the cherubim moved, the wheels would move beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise off the earth, the wheels also did not turn away from beside them.
verses.10:17: When those stood still, these stood still, and when those rose up, these rose up with them, because the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.10:18: Then the glory of the LORD went out from over the threshold of the house and stood above the cherubim.
verses.10:19: And the cherubim lifted up their wings and rose from the earth before my eyes as they went out, with the wheels alongside them; and they stood at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the LORD, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them from above.
verses.10:20: This was the living creature that I had seen beneath the God of Israel at the Chebar River, and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.10:21: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings, and the likeness of human hands was underneath their wings.
verses.10:22: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the very faces that I had seen by the Chebar River—their appearance and themselves. Each one moved straight forward.
verses.11:1: Then a spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the LORD, which faces eastward. And look, at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, officials of the people.
verses.11:2: And He said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and give wicked counsel in this city,
verses.11:3: who say, 'Building houses is not near; it is the pot, and we are the meat.'
verses.11:4: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man!"
verses.11:5: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said to me, "Say, 'This is what the LORD says: So you have spoken, house of Israel, and the things that rise in your spirit—I know them.
verses.11:6: You have multiplied those you have killed in this city, and you have filled its streets with the dead.
verses.11:7: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Those you have killed, whom you have laid in its midst—they are the meat, and it is the pot; but you will be brought out from its midst.
verses.11:8: You have feared a sword, and a sword I will bring upon you, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.11:9: And I will bring you out from its midst, and I will give you into the hand of foreigners, and I will execute judgments against you.
verses.11:10: By the sword you will fall; at the border of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.11:11: It will not be a pot for you, nor will you be meat in its midst; at the border of Israel I will judge you.
verses.11:12: And you will know that I am the LORD, for you have not walked in My statutes nor carried out My ordinances, but you have acted according to the ordinances of the nations that are around you.'"
verses.11:13: Now it happened, as I was prophesying, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Are You making a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"
verses.11:14: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.11:15: "Son of man, your brothers, your brothers, the men of your kinship, and all the house of Israel, the whole of it—they are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'Stay far away from the LORD; to us this land has been given as a possession.'
verses.11:16: Therefore say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Though I have sent them far away among the nations and though I have scattered them through the lands, yet I have become a sanctuary for them in small measure in the lands where they have gone.'
verses.11:17: Therefore say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the lands in which you have been scattered, and I will give to you the land of Israel.
verses.11:18: And they will come there and remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
verses.11:19: I will give to them a single heart, and I will place a new spirit within you; I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give to them a heart of flesh,
verses.11:20: so that they may walk in My statutes and observe My ordinances and carry them out; and they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them.
verses.11:21: But as for those whose heart goes after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own head, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.11:22: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels alongside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them from above.
verses.11:23: And the glory of the LORD went up from over the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain that is east of the city.
verses.11:24: And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to Chaldea, to the exiles, in the vision by the Spirit of God. Then the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.11:25: Then I spoke to the exiles all the words of the LORD that He had shown me.
verses.12:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.12:2: "Son of man, you are living in the midst of the house of rebellion, who have eyes to see yet do not see, ears to hear yet do not hear, for they are a house of rebellion.
verses.12:3: And you, son of man, make ready for yourself belongings for exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes; you shall go into exile from your place to another place before their eyes. Perhaps they will see, though they are a house of rebellion.
verses.12:4: And you shall bring out your belongings like belongings for exile by day before their eyes; and you yourself shall go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who go out into exile.
verses.12:5: Before their eyes, dig through the wall for yourself, and bring them out through it.
verses.12:6: Before their eyes you shall carry them on your shoulder and bring them out in the dark; you shall cover your face so that you do not see the land, for I have appointed you a sign to the house of Israel."
verses.12:7: And I did so, just as I was commanded. I brought out my belongings by day like belongings for exile, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself by hand; in the dark I brought them out and carried them on my shoulder before their eyes.
verses.12:8: And the word of the LORD came to me in the morning, saying,
verses.12:9: "Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the house of rebellion, say to you, 'What are you doing?'
verses.12:10: Say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: This burden is about the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are in their midst.'
verses.12:11: Say, 'I am your sign. Just as I have done, so it will be done to them: they will go into exile, into captivity.
verses.12:12: And the prince who is in their midst will carry a load on his shoulder in the dark and go out. They will dig through the wall to bring him out through it. He will cover his face so that he himself will not see the land with his eyes.
verses.12:13: And I will spread out My net over him, and he will be captured in My snare; I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
verses.12:14: And all who are around him, his helpers and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.12:15: And they will know that I am the LORD when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the lands.
verses.12:16: Yet I will spare a small number of men among them from sword, from famine, and from pestilence, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they go; and they will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.12:17: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.12:18: "Son of man, you shall eat your bread with trembling, and you shall drink your water with agitation and with anxiety.
verses.12:19: And you shall say to the people of the land, 'This is what the Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem on the soil of Israel: They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, so that her land will be desolated of all its fullness because of the violence of all who live in it.
verses.12:20: And the inhabited cities will fall into ruin, and the land will become a desolation; then you will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.12:21: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.12:22: "Son of man, what is this proverb you have on the soil of Israel, saying, 'The days stretch out, and every vision perishes'?
verses.12:23: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer repeat it as a proverb in Israel.' Instead, speak to them, 'The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
verses.12:24: For there will no longer be any empty vision or flattering divination in the midst of the house of Israel.
verses.12:25: For I, the LORD, will speak, and whatever word I speak will be done; it will not be postponed any longer. For in your days, house of rebellion, I will speak a word and do it, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.12:26: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.12:27: "Son of man, look, the house of Israel is saying, 'The vision that he sees is for many days ahead, and for distant times he is prophesying.'
verses.12:28: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Not one of My words will be postponed any longer; whatever word I speak will be done, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.13:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.13:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are prophesying, and say to those who are prophets from their own hearts, 'Hear the word of the LORD!
verses.13:3: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe upon the foolish prophets who walk after their own spirit and have seen nothing!
verses.13:4: Like foxes in the ruins have your prophets been, Israel.
verses.13:5: You did not go up into the breaches, nor did you build up a wall around the house of Israel to stand in the battle on the day of the LORD.
verses.13:6: They have seen emptiness and lying divination, those who say, "The LORD declares," when the LORD has not sent them; yet they wait for the word to be confirmed.
verses.13:7: Have you not seen an empty vision and spoken a lying divination, saying, "The LORD declares," though I have not spoken?
verses.13:8: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have spoken emptiness and seen lies, therefore, look, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.13:9: And My hand will be against the prophets who see emptiness and who divine lies. They will not be in the council of My people, nor will they be written in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they come to the soil of Israel; and you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.13:10: Because, yes, because they have misled My people, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and when one builds a flimsy wall, look, they plaster it with whitewash.'
verses.13:11: Say to those who plaster with whitewash that it will fall: 'A flooding rain will come, and you, hailstones, will fall, and a stormy wind will break out.
verses.13:12: And look, the wall has fallen! Will it not be said to you, "Where is the plaster with which you plastered it?"
verses.13:13: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will cause a stormy wind to break out in My fury, and a flooding rain will come in My anger, and hailstones in fury for complete destruction.
verses.13:14: And I will demolish the wall that you plastered with whitewash and bring it down to the ground, and its foundation will be uncovered. And it will fall, and you will be consumed in its midst; and you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.13:15: And I will exhaust My fury against the wall and against those who plastered it with whitewash, and I will say to you, "The wall is no more, nor are those who plastered it—
verses.13:16: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and who see for her a vision of peace when there is no peace," declares the Lord GOD.'
verses.13:17: As for you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own hearts, and prophesy against them.
verses.13:18: And say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew bands onto all wrists and make veils for the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of My people, and keep souls alive for yourselves?
verses.13:19: And you have profaned Me before My people for handfuls of barley and for morsels of bread, to put to death souls that ought not to die and to keep alive souls that ought not to live, by telling lies to My people, who listen to lies.
verses.13:20: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against your bands with which you hunt souls like birds; I will tear them off your arms, and I will set free the souls that you are hunting, even those souls, like birds.
verses.13:21: And I will tear away your veils and rescue My people from your hand, and they will no longer be prey in your hand; then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.13:22: Because you have disheartened the heart of the righteous with falsehood, though I Myself had not caused him pain, and have strengthened the hands of the wicked so that he would not turn back from his evil way to preserve his life,
verses.13:23: therefore, you will not see emptiness, nor will you practice divination any longer; and I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.14:1: Now men from among the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
verses.14:2: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.14:3: "Son of man, these men have brought up their idols upon their heart and have placed the stumbling block of their iniquity directly in front of their faces. Should I truly allow Myself to be inquired of by them?
verses.14:4: Therefore speak with them and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Any man from the house of Israel who brings up his idols into his heart and sets the stumbling block of his iniquity directly in front of his face, and comes to the prophet, I, the LORD, will respond to him who comes with the abundance of his idols,
verses.14:5: in order to seize the house of Israel in their heart, because all of them have become estranged from Me through their idols.'
verses.14:6: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Turn back and turn away from your idols, and from all your abominations turn your faces away.
verses.14:7: For any man from the house of Israel, or from the sojourner who resides in Israel, who separates himself from following Me and brings up his idols into his heart, and sets the stumbling block of his iniquity directly in front of his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire of Me for himself, I, the LORD, will respond to him by Myself.
verses.14:8: And I will set My face against that man and turn him into a sign and bywords, and cut him off from the midst of My people; then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.14:9: And as for the prophet, if he is enticed and speaks a word, I, the LORD, have enticed that prophet; and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.14:10: And they will bear their iniquity; as the iniquity of the inquirer is, so will the iniquity of the prophet be,
verses.14:11: so that the house of Israel may not wander astray from following Me anymore, nor defile themselves anymore with all their transgressions, but may be My people, and I may be their God, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.14:12: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.14:13: "Son of man, when a land sins against Me by committing treachery, and I stretch out My hand against it, and break its staff of bread, and send famine into it, and cut off from it man and beast,
verses.14:14: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel, and Job—were in its midst, they by their righteousness would rescue their own lives, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.14:15: If I cause vicious beasts to pass through the land and they bereave it, so that it becomes a desolation with no one passing through because of the beasts,
verses.14:16: though these three men were in its midst, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they would rescue neither sons nor daughters; they alone would be rescued, while the land would become a desolation.
verses.14:17: Or if I bring a sword upon that land and say, 'Let a sword pass through the land,' and I cut off from it man and beast,
verses.14:18: even though these three men were in its midst, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they would not rescue sons or daughters, but they alone would be rescued.
verses.14:19: Or if I send pestilence to that land and pour out My fury on it in blood, in order to cut off from it man and beast,
verses.14:20: even though Noah, Daniel, and Job were in its midst, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they would rescue neither son nor daughter; they by their righteousness would rescue their own lives.
verses.14:21: For this is what the Lord GOD says: How much more when I send My four disastrous judgments—sword, famine, vicious beasts, and pestilence—against Jerusalem, to cut off from it man and beast!
verses.14:22: Yet now, survivors will be left in it who will be brought out, sons and daughters; look, they are coming out to you, and you will see their way and their deeds, and you will be consoled over the disaster that I have brought upon Jerusalem—all that I have brought upon it.
verses.14:23: And they will console you when you see their way and their deeds; and you will know that not without reason have I done all that I have done in it, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.15:1: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.15:2: "Son of man, how is the wood of the vine superior to any other wood—the vine branch that is among the trees of the forest?
verses.15:3: Is wood taken from it to be used for any work? Or do people take a peg from it on which to hang any vessel?
verses.15:4: Look, it has been given to the fire to be consumed; the fire has consumed both of its ends, and its middle is charred. Is it fit for any work?
verses.15:5: Look, while it was whole, it could not be used for any work; how much less, when fire has consumed it and it has been charred, can it still be used for any work?
verses.15:6: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Just as the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire to be consumed, so I have given over the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.15:7: And I will set My face against them; from the fire they have come out, yet the fire will consume them, and you will know that I am the LORD when I set My face against them.
verses.15:8: And I will make the land a desolation, because they have committed treachery, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.16:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.16:2: "Son of man, make Jerusalem know her abominations,
verses.16:3: and say, This is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origins and your birth are from the land of the Canaanite; your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
verses.16:4: And as for your birth, on the day you were born, your umbilical cord was not cut, you were not washed in water for cleansing, you were not rubbed with salt at all, and you were not swaddled at all.
verses.16:5: No eye took pity on you to do any one of these things for you, to show you compassion; instead, you were thrown out onto the open field in loathing of your life on the day you were born.
verses.16:6: Then I passed by you and saw you thrashing in your blood, and I said to you, 'In your blood, live!' And I said to you, 'In your blood, live!'
verses.16:7: I made you a myriad, like the growth of the field; you increased and grew up and came into the finest of ornaments. Your breasts became firm and your hair grew out, though you were naked and bare.
verses.16:8: Then I passed by you and saw you, and look, your time was the time for love. So I spread the edge of My garment over you and covered your nakedness; I swore an oath to you and entered a covenant with you, declares the Lord GOD, and you became Mine.
verses.16:9: Then I washed you in water, rinsed your blood off you, and anointed you with oil.
verses.16:10: I dressed you in embroidered cloth and put fine leather sandals on you; I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.16:11: I adorned you with jewelry, and I placed bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck.
verses.16:12: I also set a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears, and a crown of splendor on your head.
verses.16:13: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your attire was fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate choice flour, honey, and oil, and you became exceedingly beautiful and rose to royalty.
verses.16:14: Your renown went out among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was complete through My majesty that I had placed on you, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.16:15: Yet you trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your renown, and you poured out your acts of prostitution on every passerby; his it became.
verses.16:16: You took some of your garments, made for yourself multicolored high places, and prostituted yourself on them; such things have never come about and never will be.
verses.16:17: You also took your jewels of splendor, of My gold and My silver that I had given you, and made for yourself male images and prostituted yourself with them.
verses.16:18: You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you placed My oil and My incense before them.
verses.16:19: And My bread that I gave you, choice flour, oil, and honey that I fed you, you set before them as a soothing fragrance; and so it was, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.16:20: You took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne to Me, and you sacrificed them to them to be devoured. Were your acts of prostitution too small a matter,
verses.16:21: that you slaughtered My children and gave them up by causing them to pass over to them?
verses.16:22: And with all your abominations and your acts of prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, when you were thrashing in your blood.
verses.16:23: And it happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you, declares the Lord GOD—
verses.16:24: that you built yourself a vaulted mound and made yourself a lofty platform in every open square.
verses.16:25: At the head of every road you built your lofty platform, made your beauty an abomination, spread your legs to every passerby, and multiplied your acts of prostitution.
verses.16:26: You also prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, large of flesh, and you multiplied your prostitution to provoke Me to anger.
verses.16:27: So look, I stretched out My hand against you, reduced your ration, and gave you over to the appetite of those who hated you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd way.
verses.16:28: Then you prostituted yourself with the sons of Assyria because you were unsatisfied; you prostituted yourself with them, and even then you were not satisfied.
verses.16:29: And you multiplied your prostitution toward the land of commerce, to Chaldea, and even with this you were not satisfied.
verses.16:30: How feeble is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, when you do all these things, the deeds of a domineering prostitute!
verses.16:31: When you built your vaulted mound at the head of every road and made your lofty platform in every open square, you were not like a prostitute, for you scoffed at payment.
verses.16:32: Adulterous wife! In place of her husband, she takes strangers!
verses.16:33: To all prostitutes they give a gift, yet you gave your gifts to all your lovers and bribed them to come to you from all around for your acts of prostitution.
verses.16:34: So in you it was the reverse of other women in your acts of prostitution: no one went after you for prostitution, and because you gave payment while no payment was given to you, you became the reverse.
verses.16:35: Therefore, prostitute, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.16:36: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because your lust was poured out and your nakedness was exposed in your acts of prostitution with your lovers and with all the idols of your abominations, and because of the blood of your children whom you gave to them,
verses.16:37: therefore look, I am about to gather all your lovers to whom you were pleasing, all whom you loved along with all whom you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and expose your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.
verses.16:38: I will judge you with the judgments for women who commit adultery and who shed blood, and I will give you the bloodshed of fury and jealousy.
verses.16:39: I will deliver you into their hand, and they will tear down your vaulted mound and demolish your lofty platforms; they will strip you of your garments, take your jewels of splendor, and leave you naked and bare.
verses.16:40: They will bring up an assembly against you, stone you with stones, and hack you to pieces with their swords.
verses.16:41: They will burn your houses with fire and carry out judgments against you before the eyes of many women. I will cause you to cease from being a prostitute, and you will also no longer give payment.
verses.16:42: Then I will lay My fury to rest upon you, and My jealousy will turn away from you; I will grow quiet and will not be angry anymore.
verses.16:43: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but enraged Me with all these things, look, I too have brought your way upon your head, declares the Lord GOD. Did you not commit this lewdness on top of all your abominations?
verses.16:44: Look, everyone who speaks proverbs will speak this proverb about you, saying, 'Like mother, like daughter.'
verses.16:45: You are the daughter of your mother, who abhors her husband and her children, and you are the sister of your sisters, who abhorred their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father was an Amorite.
verses.16:46: And your older sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwells at your left; and your sister younger than you, who dwells on your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.16:47: You did not merely walk in their ways and act according to their abominations; as if that were a very small thing, you acted more corruptly than they did in all your ways.
verses.16:48: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, Sodom your sister, she and her daughters, did not act as you and your daughters have acted.
verses.16:49: Look, this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and tranquil ease belonged to her and her daughters, yet she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.16:50: They grew haughty and committed an abomination before Me, so I took them away when I saw it.
verses.16:51: And Samaria did not sin half of your sins; you multiplied your abominations more than they and made your sisters seem righteous through all your abominations that you have done.
verses.16:52: You too, bear your disgrace, you who have judged in favor of your sister; because of your sins in which you acted more abominably than they, they are more righteous than you. So you too, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, in making your sisters seem righteous.
verses.16:53: Yet I will restore their fortunes, the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and the fortunes of Samaria and her daughters, and the restoration of your own fortunes in their midst,
verses.16:54: so that you may bear your disgrace and be humiliated for all that you have done, in comforting them.
verses.16:55: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former condition, and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former condition, and you and your daughters will return to your former condition.
verses.16:56: Was Sodom your sister not a byword in your mouth on the day of your pride,
verses.16:57: before your wickedness was exposed, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Aram and all those around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you from all around?
verses.16:58: Your lewdness and your abominations, you yourself bear them, declares the LORD.
verses.16:59: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you just as you have done, because you despised the oath by violating the covenant.
verses.16:60: Yet I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an eternal covenant for you.
verses.16:61: Then you will remember your ways and be humiliated when you receive your sisters, both those older than you and those younger than you; and I will give them to you as daughters, though not on account of your covenant.
verses.16:62: And I Myself will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,
verses.16:63: in order that you may remember and be ashamed, and no longer open your mouth because of your disgrace, when I make atonement for you for all that you have done, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.17:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.17:2: "Son of man, pose a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
verses.17:3: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: The great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of plumage with variegated colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
verses.17:4: He plucked off the topmost of its young shoots and brought it to a land of trade; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.17:5: He also took from the seed of the land and put it in a field for sowing; he took it beside abundant waters and set it like a willow.
verses.17:6: And it sprouted and became a spreading vine, low in stature, so that its branches turned toward him while its roots remained under it. Thus it became a vine, produced shoots, and sent out boughs.
verses.17:7: Now there was another great eagle with great wings and abundant plumage. And look, this vine bent its roots toward him and sent out its branches to him, so that he might water it from the beds of its planting.
verses.17:8: In a good field beside abundant waters it was planted, to produce branches and bear fruit, to become a majestic vine.'
verses.17:9: Say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Will it prosper? Will he not tear out its roots and strip off its fruit so that it withers? All the fresh leaves of its growth will wither, and it will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by its roots.
verses.17:10: And look, though it is planted, will it prosper? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind strikes it? On the beds where it sprouted it will wither.'"
verses.17:11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.17:12: "Say now to the rebellious house, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Say, 'Look, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its officials, and brought them to himself in Babylon.
verses.17:13: He also took one from the royal seed and made a covenant with him, bringing him under an oath, and he took away the mighty men of the land,
verses.17:14: so that the kingdom would be lowly and not lift itself up, keeping his covenant in order that it might stand.
verses.17:15: But he rebelled against him by sending his messengers to Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one who does these things escape? Can he break a covenant and still escape?
verses.17:16: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, with him in the midst of Babylon he will die.
verses.17:17: Nor will Pharaoh with a great army and a numerous company act for him in the war, when they cast up a siege mound and build a siege wall to cut off many lives.
verses.17:18: For he despised an oath by breaking a covenant, and look, he had given his hand, yet he did all these things; he will not escape.
verses.17:19: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: As I live, surely My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke, I will bring it upon his own head.
verses.17:20: I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. And I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgment with him there for his treachery by which he acted treacherously against Me.
verses.17:21: And all his fugitives among all his troops will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
verses.17:22: This is what the Lord GOD says: "I Myself will also take from the lofty top of the cedar and set it out; from the topmost of its young shoots I will pluck off a tender one, and I Myself will plant it on a high and towering mountain.
verses.17:23: On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it, so that it will bear branches and produce fruit and become a majestic cedar. Every bird of every wing will dwell beneath it; in the shade of its branches they will dwell.
verses.17:24: And all the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought low the high tree and raised high the low tree, have dried up the green tree and made the dry tree blossom. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it."
verses.18:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.18:2: "What is it to you that you quote this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, 'Fathers eat sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge'?
verses.18:3: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will surely no longer have occasion to quote this proverb in Israel.
verses.18:4: See, all souls belong to Me; like the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son belongs to Me. The soul that sins is the one that will die.
verses.18:5: Now if a man is righteous and practices justice and righteousness:
verses.18:6: if he does not eat at the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife, and does not approach a woman in her menstrual impurity;
verses.18:7: if he does not oppress anyone, returns the pledge for a debt, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment;
verses.18:8: if he does not lend at interest or take any increase, holds back his hand from injustice, and executes true justice between one man and another;
verses.18:9: if he walks in My statutes and keeps My ordinances to act in truth, he is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.18:10: Now if he fathers a violent son who sheds blood and who does any one of these things to a brother,
verses.18:11: though he himself has done none of those things, but has even eaten at the mountains and defiled his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:12: has oppressed the poor and needy, has committed robberies, does not return a pledge, has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
verses.18:13: has lent at interest and taken increase—will he then live? He will not live! He has committed all these abominations; he will surely be put to death. His blood will be upon him.
verses.18:14: Now look, if he fathers a son who sees all the sins that his father committed, and he considers them and does not act like them:
verses.18:15: if he does not eat on the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife,
verses.18:16: does not oppress anyone, exacts no pledge, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment;
verses.18:17: holds back his hand from the poor, takes neither interest nor increase, carries out My ordinances, and walks in My statutes—he will not die for the iniquity of his father; he will surely live.
verses.18:18: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, committed robbery against a brother, and did what is not good among his people, look, he will die for his own iniquity.
verses.18:19: Yet you say, 'Why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father?' Because the son has practiced justice and righteousness and has kept all My statutes and carried them out, he will surely live.
verses.18:20: The soul that sins is the one that will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous one will be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked one will be on him.
verses.18:21: But if the wicked one turns back from all his sins that he has committed and keeps all My statutes and practices justice and righteousness, he will surely live; he will not die.
verses.18:22: None of the transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him; by the righteousness that he has practiced, he will live.
verses.18:23: Do I delight at all in the death of a wicked one, declares the Lord GOD, and not rather that he turn back from his ways and live?
verses.18:24: But when a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits injustice, doing according to all the abominations that the wicked one has committed—will he then live? None of the righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered; for his treachery that he has committed and for his sin that he has sinned, in them he will die.
verses.18:25: Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Hear now, house of Israel: is My way not fair? Is it not your ways that are not fair?
verses.18:26: When a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits injustice and dies because of them, it is for his injustice that he has committed that he will die.
verses.18:27: Again, when a wicked one turns away from his wickedness that he has committed and practices justice and righteousness, he himself will keep his soul alive.
verses.18:28: Because he considers and turns back from all his transgressions that he has committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
verses.18:29: Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Are My ways not fair, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not fair?
verses.18:30: Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each person according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Turn back and turn away from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not become a stumbling block to you.
verses.18:31: Throw off from yourselves all the transgressions by which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! And why will you die, house of Israel?
verses.18:32: For I take no delight in the death of anyone who dies, declares the Lord GOD. So turn back and live!"
verses.19:1: "And you, raise a lamentation over the princes of Israel,
verses.19:2: and say, 'What a lioness was your mother! Among lions she lay down; in the midst of young lions she raised her cubs.
verses.19:3: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. He learned to tear prey; he devoured people.
verses.19:4: Then nations heard about him; in their pit he was caught, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.19:5: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope had perished, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
verses.19:6: He walked about among lions; he became a young lion. He learned to tear prey; he devoured people.
verses.19:7: He violated their widows and laid waste their cities, and the land and its fullness became desolate at the sound of his roaring.
verses.19:8: Then nations set themselves against him from the provinces all around; they spread their net over him, and in their pit he was caught.
verses.19:9: With hooks they put him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.19:10: Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted beside waters; she became fruitful and full of branches because of abundant waters.
verses.19:11: And she had strong branches for scepters of rulers; its stature grew high among the thick boughs, and it stood out in its height with the abundance of its branches.
verses.19:12: But she was uprooted in fury and thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit; her strong branch was broken off and withered, and fire consumed it.
verses.19:13: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a land of drought and thirst.
verses.19:14: And fire has gone out from a branch of her shoots and consumed her fruit, so that no strong branch remains in her, no scepter for ruling.' This is a lamentation, and it has become a lamentation."
verses.20:1: Now it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, that men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.
verses.20:2: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.20:3: "Son of man, speak with the elders of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Is it to inquire of Me that you are coming? As I live, I will certainly not let Myself be inquired of by you, declares the Lord GOD.'
verses.20:4: Will you judge them? Will you judge, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers.
verses.20:5: And say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I lifted My hand to the seed of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt, and I lifted My hand to them, saying, "I am the LORD your God."
verses.20:6: On that day I lifted My hand to them to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had scouted out for them, flowing with milk and honey; it is the splendor of all the lands.
verses.20:7: And I said to them, "Each of you, throw away the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am the LORD your God."
verses.20:8: But they rebelled against Me and were unwilling to listen to Me; not one of them threw away the detestable things of their eyes, and they did not abandon the idols of Egypt. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them, to exhaust My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:9: Yet I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations in whose midst they were, before whose eyes I had made Myself known to them in bringing them out from the land of Egypt.
verses.20:10: So I brought them out from the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.20:11: And I gave them My statutes and made My ordinances known to them, by which a person will live if he does them.
verses.20:12: I also gave them My Sabbaths to serve as a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
verses.20:13: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not walk in My statutes, and they rejected My ordinances, by which a person will live if he does them, and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness to bring an end to them.
verses.20:14: Yet I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.
verses.20:15: Moreover, I also lifted My hand to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given, flowing with milk and honey—it is the splendor of all the lands—
verses.20:16: because they rejected My ordinances, and did not walk in My statutes, and profaned My Sabbaths; for their heart was going after their idols.
verses.20:17: Yet My eye had pity on them so as not to destroy them, and I did not make a complete end of them in the wilderness.
verses.20:18: And I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their ordinances, and do not defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.20:19: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and do them.
verses.20:20: And sanctify My Sabbaths, and they will serve as a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God."
verses.20:21: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes, and they did not keep My ordinances to do them, by which a person will live if he does them; they profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them, to exhaust My anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.20:22: Yet I drew back My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.
verses.20:23: Moreover, I lifted My hand to them in the wilderness to scatter them among the nations and to disperse them across the lands,
verses.20:24: because they did not do My ordinances, and they rejected My statutes, and they profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the idols of their fathers.
verses.20:25: And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they would not live.
verses.20:26: And I defiled them through their gifts, as they caused everything that opens the womb to pass over, so that I might appall them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.'
verses.20:27: Therefore, speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: In this too your fathers blasphemed Me, by committing treachery against Me.
verses.20:28: When I brought them into the land that I lifted My hand to give to them, they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and there they sacrificed their sacrifices, and there they gave the provocation of their offering, and there they placed their soothing fragrances, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
verses.20:29: Then I said to them, "What is the high place to which you are going?" So its name is called Bamah to this day.'
verses.20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you defiling yourselves in the way of your fathers, and prostituting yourselves after their detestable things?
verses.20:31: And when you lift up your gifts, in making your children pass through the fire, you are defiling yourselves with all your idols to this day. And should I let Myself be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will certainly not let Myself be inquired of by you.
verses.20:32: And what rises in your spirit will certainly never happen, when you say, "We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, ministering to wood and stone."
verses.20:33: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will reign over you.
verses.20:34: And I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
verses.20:35: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and I will contend in judgment with you there, face to face.
verses.20:36: Just as I contended in judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will contend in judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.20:37: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you within the bond of the covenant.
verses.20:38: And I will purge from among you the rebels and those who transgress against Me; from the land of their sojourning I will bring them out, yet none of them will enter the soil of Israel. And you will know that I am the LORD.
