verses.20:39: As for you, house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go, serve each one his idols, and afterward, if you will not listen to Me; yet My holy name you must not profane anymore with your gifts and with your idols.
verses.20:40: For on My holy mountain, on the mountain height of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there all the house of Israel, all of it in the land, will serve Me. There I will accept them, and there I will require your contributions and the finest of your tribute offerings, along with all your holy gifts.
verses.20:41: As a soothing fragrance I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered; and I will show Myself holy among you before the eyes of the nations.
verses.20:42: And you will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the soil of Israel, into the land that I lifted My hand to give to your fathers.
verses.20:43: And there you will remember your ways and all your deeds by which you defiled yourselves, and you will feel loathing for yourselves in your own sight because of all your evils that you have done.
verses.20:44: And you will know that I am the LORD when I deal with you for the sake of My name, not according to your evil ways nor according to your corrupt deeds, house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.21:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.21:2: "Son of man, set your face toward the south, drop words toward the southland, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the Negev.
verses.21:3: And say to the forest of the Negev, 'Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you. The blazing flame will not be extinguished, and all faces from south to north will be scorched by it.
verses.21:4: And all flesh will see that I, the LORD, have set it ablaze; it will not be extinguished.'"
verses.21:5: Then I said, "Alas, Lord GOD! They are saying of me, 'Is he not a speaker of parables?'"
verses.21:6: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.21:7: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, drop words toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
verses.21:8: And say to the land of Israel, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
verses.21:9: Because I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore My sword will go out from its sheath against all flesh from south to north.
verses.21:10: And all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword out of its sheath; it will not return again.'
verses.21:11: As for you, son of man, groan! With breaking loins and with bitterness you shall groan before their eyes.
verses.21:12: And when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming! Every heart will melt, all hands will go limp, every spirit will grow faint, and all knees will run with water. Look, it is coming and it will happen, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.21:13: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.21:14: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord says!' Say, 'A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished!
verses.21:15: To make a slaughter it is sharpened; to have a flash of lightning it is polished. Or shall we rejoice? The scepter of My son despises every tree.
verses.21:16: And it was given to be polished, to be grasped in the palm; this sword is sharpened and it is polished, to give it into the hand of a killer.'
verses.21:17: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against My people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They have been cast to the sword along with My people; therefore strike your thigh.
verses.21:18: For there is a testing; and what if even the despising scepter will be no more?" declares the Lord GOD.
verses.21:19: "And you, son of man, prophesy and strike palm against palm! Let the sword be doubled a third time, the sword of the fatally wounded; it is the sword of the great fatally wounded one, which surrounds them.
verses.21:20: So that hearts may melt and stumblings multiply, at all their gates I have set the threat of the sword. Ah! It is made for a flash of lightning, wrapped for slaughter.
verses.21:21: Gather yourself, turn right! Set yourself, turn left, wherever your face is directed!
verses.21:22: I also will strike My palm against My palm, and I will put My wrath to rest. I, the LORD, have spoken."
verses.21:23: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.21:24: "And you, son of man, lay out for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; both of them shall go out from one land. And carve a signpost; at the head of the road to a city, carve it.
verses.21:25: You shall lay out a road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and to Judah in fortified Jerusalem.
verses.21:26: For the king of Babylon stood at the fork in the road, at the head of the two roads, to practice divination; he shook the arrows, he consulted the teraphim, he looked at the liver.
verses.21:27: Into his right hand came the divination for Jerusalem: to set battering rams, to open the mouth for killing, to raise the voice with a battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up a siege ramp, and to build a siege wall.
verses.21:28: And to them it will be like a false divination in their eyes, bound as they are by solemn oaths; yet he brings iniquity to remembrance so that they may be seized.
verses.21:29: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have brought your iniquity to remembrance, in that your transgressions are uncovered so that your sins appear in all your deeds—because you have been brought to remembrance, you will be seized by the hand.
verses.21:30: And as for you, fatally wounded wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come at the time of final iniquity:
verses.21:31: This is what the Lord GOD says: Remove the turban and lift off the crown! This will not remain what it is: lift up what is low, and bring low what is high.
verses.21:32: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! This also will not be, until he comes to whom the right belongs, and I will give it to him.
verses.21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach.' And say, 'A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to the utmost, for a flash of lightning,
verses.21:34: while they see false visions for you, while they divine lies for you, to place you upon the necks of the fatally wounded wicked, whose day has come at the time of final iniquity.
verses.21:35: Return it to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
verses.21:36: And I will pour out My indignation upon you; with the fire of My fury I will blow upon you, and I will give you into the hand of brutish men, craftsmen of destruction.
verses.21:37: You will become fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land; you will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
verses.22:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.22:2: "And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her abominations,
verses.22:3: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: A city shedding blood in her midst so that her time will come, and making idols against herself to become unclean!
verses.22:4: By your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your idols that you have made you have become unclean; you have brought your days near and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
verses.22:5: Those near and those far from you will mock you, you of unclean name, full of turmoil!
verses.22:6: Look, the princes of Israel, each according to his might, have been in you in order to shed blood.
verses.22:7: Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; toward the sojourner they have dealt with oppression in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have wronged in you.
verses.22:8: My holy things you have despised, and My Sabbaths you have profaned.
verses.22:9: Men of slander have been in you in order to shed blood; upon the mountains they have eaten in you; they have committed lewdness in your midst.
verses.22:10: In you a father's nakedness has been uncovered; in you they have violated a woman unclean in her menstruation.
verses.22:11: One man has committed an abomination with his neighbor's wife, another has defiled his daughter-in-law in lewdness, and another in you has violated his sister, his father's daughter.
verses.22:12: In you they have taken bribes in order to shed blood; you have taken interest and increase, and you have made dishonest gain from your neighbors by oppression, and Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.22:13: And look, I have struck My palm at your dishonest gain that you have made, and at your bloodshed that has been in your midst.
verses.22:14: Will your heart stand firm, or will your hands remain strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
verses.22:15: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the lands, and I will put an end to your uncleanness from you.
verses.22:16: And you will be profaned in yourself before the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.22:17: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.22:18: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the midst of a furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
verses.22:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because all of you have become dross, therefore, look, I am gathering you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.22:20: As a gathering of silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire upon it to melt it, so I will gather you in My anger and in My wrath, and I will place you there and melt you.
verses.22:21: And I will collect you and blow upon you with the fire of My fury, and you will be melted in the midst of it.
verses.22:22: As the melting of silver in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in the midst of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you."
verses.22:23: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.22:24: "Son of man, say to her, 'You are a land that is not cleansed, not rained upon in the day of indignation.'
verses.22:25: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst; like a roaring lion tearing prey, they have devoured lives, they take treasure and precious things, and they have multiplied her widows in her midst.
verses.22:26: Her priests have done violence to My law and have profaned My holy things; they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, nor have they made known the difference between the unclean and the clean; they have hidden their eyes from My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned in their midst.
verses.22:27: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing prey, shedding blood and destroying lives in order to get dishonest gain.
verses.22:28: And her prophets have plastered whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken.
verses.22:29: The people of the land have practiced oppression and committed robbery; they have wronged the afflicted and the needy, and they have oppressed the sojourner without justice.
verses.22:30: And I looked among them for a man who would build up a wall and stand in the breach before Me on behalf of the land, so that I might not destroy it, yet I did not find one.
verses.22:31: Therefore I have poured out My indignation upon them; with the fire of My fury I have consumed them. Their own way I have brought upon their heads, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.23:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.23:2: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
verses.23:3: They prostituted themselves in Egypt; in their youth they prostituted themselves. There their breasts were squeezed, and there their virgin bosoms were fondled.
verses.23:4: Their names were Oholah the older and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.23:5: Oholah prostituted herself while under My authority, and she lusted for her lovers, for the Assyrians who were nearby,
verses.23:6: dressed in blue, governors and officials, desirable young men, all of them, horsemen riding on horses.
verses.23:7: She bestowed her acts of prostitution upon them, the choicest of the sons of Assyria, all of them; and with everyone for whom she lusted, she defiled herself with all their idols.
verses.23:8: Nor did she abandon her acts of prostitution from Egypt, for they had lain with her in her youth, and they had fondled her virgin bosoms and poured out their prostitution upon her.
verses.23:9: Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the sons of Assyria for whom she lusted.
verses.23:10: They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. So she became a byword among women, and they carried out judgments against her.
verses.23:11: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she corrupted her lust more than she did, and her acts of prostitution more than the prostitution of her sister.
verses.23:12: She lusted for the sons of Assyria, governors and officials who were nearby, dressed in full splendor, horsemen riding on horses, desirable young men, all of them.
verses.23:13: And I saw that she had defiled herself; there was one way for both of them.
verses.23:14: Yet she added to her acts of prostitution: she saw men portrayed on the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn in vermilion,
verses.23:15: belted with sashes around their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them having the appearance of officers—the likeness of the sons of Babylon, Chaldea being the land of their birth.
verses.23:16: She lusted for them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them, to Chaldea.
verses.23:17: So the sons of Babylon came to her to the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution; she became defiled by them, and then her soul grew estranged from them.
verses.23:18: She uncovered her acts of prostitution and uncovered her nakedness; so My soul grew estranged from her, just as My soul had grown estranged from her sister.
verses.23:19: Yet she multiplied her acts of prostitution, recalling the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.
verses.23:20: And she lusted for their paramours, whose flesh was the flesh of donkeys and whose emission was the emission of horses.
verses.23:21: So you yearned for the lewdness of your youth, when those from Egypt fondled your bosoms on account of your youthful breasts.
verses.23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Look, I am stirring up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul grew estranged, and I will bring them against you from every side:
verses.23:23: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the sons of Assyria with them—desirable young men, governors and officials, all of them, officers and men of renown, riding on horses, all of them.
verses.23:24: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with an assembly of peoples. They will array large shield, small shield, and helmet against you all around; and I will place judgment before them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
verses.23:25: I will set My jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will remove your nose and your ears, and your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
verses.23:26: They will also strip you of your garments and take your ornaments of splendor.
verses.23:27: So I will make your lewdness cease from you, along with your prostitution from the land of Egypt; you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor will you remember Egypt anymore.'
verses.23:28: For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Look, I am giving you into the hand of those whom you hate, into the hand of those from whom your soul grew estranged.
verses.23:29: They will deal with you in hatred, take all you have labored for, and leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, along with your lewdness and your acts of prostitution.
verses.23:30: These things will be done to you for prostituting yourself after the nations, because you defiled yourself with their idols.
verses.23:31: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will place her cup into your hand.'
verses.23:32: This is what the Lord GOD says: 'You will drink your sister's cup, the deep and wide one; you will become an object of laughter and derision—so much does it hold.
verses.23:33: With drunkenness and grief you will be filled—a cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.23:34: You will drink it and drain it dry, and you will gnaw its potsherds and tear your breasts; for I have spoken,' declares the Lord GOD.
verses.23:35: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, you too bear your lewdness and your acts of prostitution.'"
verses.23:36: Then the LORD said to me, "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
verses.23:37: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. With their idols they have committed adultery, and even their sons whom they bore to Me they caused to pass over to them as food.
verses.23:38: Moreover, they did this to Me: they defiled My sanctuary on that very day, and they profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.23:39: When they had slaughtered their sons for their idols, they came into My sanctuary on that very day to profane it. And look, this is what they did in the midst of My house.
verses.23:40: Furthermore, they even sent for men coming from afar, to whom a messenger was sent, and look, they came! For them you bathed, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments.
verses.23:41: You sat on a stately couch with a table set before it, and you placed My incense and My oil on it.
verses.23:42: The sound of a carefree crowd was with her; and in addition to men from the masses of people, Sabeans were brought from the wilderness, and they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of splendor on their heads.
verses.23:43: Then I said concerning the one worn out by adulteries, 'Now they will practice her prostitution—even she!'
verses.23:44: So men went in to her, as one goes in to a prostitute; in the same way they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the women of lewdness.
verses.23:45: But righteous men—they will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
verses.23:46: For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Bring up an assembly against them, and give them over to terror and plunder.
verses.23:47: The assembly will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.
verses.23:48: So I will make lewdness cease from the land, and all the women will take warning and will not act according to your lewdness.
verses.23:49: They will lay your lewdness upon you, and you will bear the sins of your idols; and you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
verses.24:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,
verses.24:2: "Son of man, write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has closed in against Jerusalem on this very day.
verses.24:3: Speak a parable to the rebellious house and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Put the pot on, put it on, and pour water into it as well.
verses.24:4: Gather its pieces into it, every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder; fill it with the choicest bones.
verses.24:5: Take the choicest of the flock, and also pile the bones beneath it; bring it to a vigorous boil, so that even its bones are cooked within it.
verses.24:6: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed, the pot whose corrosion is in it, and whose corrosion has not come out of it! Empty it out piece by piece; no lot has fallen upon it.
verses.24:7: For her blood was in her midst; she set it upon a bare rock; she did not pour it out on the ground to cover it with dust.
verses.24:8: To bring up wrath, to exact vengeance, I have put her blood on a bare rock, so that it would not be covered.
verses.24:9: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed! I Myself will also make the pyre great.
verses.24:10: Heap up the wood, kindle the fire, cook the flesh completely, mix in the spice blend, and let the bones be charred.
verses.24:11: Then set it empty on its coals, so that its bronze may heat up and glow hot, and its impurity may be melted within it, and its corrosion may be consumed.
verses.24:12: She has exhausted efforts, yet her thick corrosion does not come out of her; into the fire with her corrosion!
verses.24:13: In your impurity is lewdness. Because I sought to cleanse you, yet you did not become clean, you will not be clean from your impurity anymore until I cause My wrath to rest upon you.
verses.24:14: I, the LORD, have spoken; it is coming, and I will act. I will not hold back, nor will I spare, nor will I relent. According to your ways and according to your deeds they will judge you, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.24:15: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.24:16: "Son of man, look, I am about to take from you the delight of your eyes with a stroke; yet you shall not mourn, and you shall not weep, nor shall your tears flow.
verses.24:17: Groan in silence; do not observe mourning for the dead. Wrap your turban on yourself and place your sandals on your feet; you shall not cover your upper lip, and you shall not eat the bread of men."
verses.24:18: So in the morning I spoke to the people, and my wife died in the evening; and in the morning I did just as I had been commanded.
verses.24:19: Then the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean to us, that you are doing them?"
verses.24:20: So I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.24:21: 'Say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to profane My sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes, and the affection of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.24:22: And you will do just as I have done: you will not cover your upper lip, and you will not eat the bread of men.
verses.24:23: Your turbans will stay on your heads and your sandals on your feet; you will not mourn and you will not weep, but you will waste away in your iniquities and groan to one another.
verses.24:24: So Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes about, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
verses.24:25: "And as for you, son of man, will it not be on the day I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, the delight of their eyes, and the longing of their soul, along with their sons and their daughters—
verses.24:26: that on that day the fugitive will come to you to bring the news to your ears?
verses.24:27: On that day your mouth will be opened to the fugitive, and you will speak and no longer be mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.25:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.25:2: "Son of man, turn your face toward the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
verses.25:3: and say to the sons of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you said, "Aha!" over My sanctuary because it was profaned, and over the land of Israel because it became desolate, and over the house of Judah because they went into exile,
verses.25:4: therefore, look, I am giving you to the sons of the east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you; they themselves will eat your fruit, and they themselves will drink your milk.
verses.25:5: And I will turn Rabbah into a grazing ground for camels and the sons of Ammon into a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.25:6: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you clapped your hands and stamped with your foot, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
verses.25:7: therefore, look, I have stretched out My hand against you, and I will hand you over as plunder to the nations; I will cut you off from the peoples and cause you to perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.25:8: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because Moab and Seir say, 'Look, the house of Judah is like all the nations,'
verses.25:9: therefore, look, I am about to lay open the flank of Moab from the cities, from his frontier cities, the glory of the land—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim—
verses.25:10: to the sons of the east along with the sons of Ammon, and I will give it as a possession, so that the sons of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
verses.25:11: And upon Moab I will execute judgments, and they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.25:12: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because Edom acted in taking vengeance against the house of Judah, and incurred grievous guilt and avenged themselves upon them,
verses.25:13: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast, and I will make it a ruin; from Teman as far as Dedan they will fall by the sword.
verses.25:14: And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will act against Edom according to My anger and according to My wrath; thus they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.25:15: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and avenged themselves with contempt of soul to bring destruction with everlasting enmity,
verses.25:16: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am stretching out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and cause the remnant of the seacoast to perish.
verses.25:17: I will execute great acts of vengeance against them with wrathful rebukes; and they will know that I am the LORD when I lay My vengeance upon them."
verses.26:1: Now it happened in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.26:2: "Son of man, because Tyre has said concerning Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gates of the peoples are broken; it has swung open to me; I shall be filled—she has been laid waste,'
verses.26:3: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, just as the sea brings up its waves.
verses.26:4: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will scrape her dust away from her and make her a bare rock.
verses.26:5: She will be a place for spreading nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD; and she will become plunder for the nations.
verses.26:6: Also her daughters who are in the open country will be killed by the sword, and they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.26:7: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north, king of kings, with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly and many people.
verses.26:8: He will kill your daughters in the open country with the sword; he will set a siege wall against you, heap up a ramp against you, and raise up large shields against you.
verses.26:9: He will aim the blow of his battering ram against your walls, and he will demolish your towers with his axes.
verses.26:10: Because of the multitude of his horses, their dust will cover you; at the noise of horsemen, wheels, and chariots your walls will shake when he enters your gates, like the entry into a breached city.
verses.26:11: With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and the pillars of your strength will come down to the ground.
verses.26:12: They will loot your wealth and plunder your merchandise; they will tear down your walls and demolish your prized houses; and your stones, your timber, and your dust they will put in the midst of the water.
verses.26:13: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease, and the sound of your lyres will be heard no more.
verses.26:14: And I will make you a bare rock; you will be a place for spreading nets; you will not be built again, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.26:15: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: "At the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan, when slaughter takes place in your midst, will not the coastlands shake?
verses.26:16: Then all the princes of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be appalled over you.
verses.26:17: And they will raise a lament over you and say to you, 'How you have perished, inhabited from the seas, the renowned city, which was mighty on the sea, she and her inhabitants, who imposed their terror on all her inhabitants!
verses.26:18: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall, and the coastlands that are in the sea are dismayed at your departure.'"
verses.26:19: For this is what the Lord GOD says: "When I make you a city laid waste, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,
verses.26:20: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago, and I will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, like the ruins of long ago, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
verses.26:21: I will make you a horror, and you will be no more; you will be sought, yet you will not be found again forever, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.27:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.27:2: "Now you, son of man, raise a lamentation over Tyre,
verses.27:3: and say to Tyre, who sits at the entrances of the sea, trader of the peoples to many coastlands, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Tyre, you have said, "I am the perfection of beauty."
verses.27:4: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.27:5: With cypresses from Senir they built all the planks for you; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast upon you.
verses.27:6: With oaks from Bashan they made your oars; your deck they made of ivory in boxwood from the coastlands of Kittim.
verses.27:7: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt was your sail, to serve as a banner for you; blue and purple from the coastlands of Elishah was your covering.
verses.27:8: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were rowers for you; your wise men, Tyre, were in you—they were your helmsmen.
verses.27:9: The elders of Gebal and her wise men were in you, repairing your seams; all the ships of the sea and their sailors were in you to exchange your merchandise.
verses.27:10: Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war; they hung shield and helmet in you; they bestowed your splendor.
verses.27:11: The sons of Arvad and your army were upon your walls all around, and Gammadim were in your towers; they hung their shields upon your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
verses.27:12: Tarshish was your merchant because of the abundance of all wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they bartered for your wares.
verses.27:13: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech—they were your traders; with human lives and bronze vessels they bartered for your merchandise.
verses.27:14: From Beth-togarmah they bartered horses, riding horses, and mules for your wares.
verses.27:15: The sons of Dedan were your traders; many coastlands were the market of your hand; ivory tusks and ebony they brought back as your payment.
verses.27:16: Aram was your merchant because of the abundance of your products; with turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies they bartered for your wares.
verses.27:17: Judah and the land of Israel—they were your traders; with wheat of Minnith, fine meal, honey, oil, and balm they bartered for your merchandise.
verses.27:18: Damascus was your merchant in the abundance of your products, because of the abundance of all wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.
verses.27:19: Vedan and Javan from Uzal bartered for your wares; forged iron, cassia, and calamus were in your merchandise.
verses.27:20: Dedan was your trader in saddle blankets for riding.
verses.27:21: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar—they were the merchants of your hand; with lambs, rams, and male goats, in these they were your merchants.
verses.27:22: The traders of Sheba and Raamah—they were your traders; with the choicest of all spices, and with every precious stone and gold, they bartered for your wares.
verses.27:23: Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad were your traders.
verses.27:24: They were your traders in splendid garments, in cloaks of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of variegated fabric, bound with cords and tightly secured, in your marketplace.
verses.27:25: The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise; so you were filled and became very heavy in the heart of the seas.
verses.27:26: Those who rowed you brought you into great waters; the east wind has shattered you in the heart of the seas.
verses.27:27: Your wealth, your wares, your merchandise, your sailors and your helmsmen, those who repair your seams and those who exchange your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, along with all your company that is in your midst, will fall into the heart of the seas on the day of your downfall.
verses.27:28: At the sound of the outcry of your helmsmen, the countryside will shake.
verses.27:29: And all who grasp the oar, the sailors, and all the helmsmen of the sea will come down from their ships; they will stand on the land.
verses.27:30: And they will make their voice heard over you and cry out bitterly; they will cast dust upon their heads and roll themselves in ashes.
verses.27:32: And in their wailing they will raise a lamentation over you and chant a lament over you: "Who is like Tyre, like one silenced in the midst of the sea?
verses.27:33: When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.27:34: At the time you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company have fallen in your midst.
verses.27:35: All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings shudder with horror; their faces are convulsed.
verses.27:36: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever."'"
verses.28:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.28:2: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Because your heart has grown lofty and you have said, "I am a god; I sit in the seat of the gods in the heart of the seas," yet you are a man and not a god, though you set your heart like the heart of a god—
verses.28:3: look, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret thing is hidden from you.
verses.28:4: By your wisdom and your understanding you have gained wealth for yourself, and you have gained gold and silver in your treasuries.
verses.28:5: By the abundance of your wisdom in your trade you have multiplied your wealth, and your heart has grown lofty because of your wealth.
verses.28:6: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have set your heart like the heart of a god,
verses.28:7: therefore, look, I am bringing foreigners against you, the most ruthless of the nations; they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your radiance.
verses.28:8: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the death of those pierced through in the heart of the seas.
verses.28:9: Will you really say, "I am a god," in the presence of the one who kills you? Yet you are a man and not a god in the hand of those who pierce you.
verses.28:10: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.28:11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.28:12: "Son of man, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You set the seal on perfection, full of wisdom and complete in beauty.
verses.28:13: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering: carnelian, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise, and emerald, and gold. The craftsmanship of your tambourines and your pipes was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
verses.28:14: You were an anointed, overshadowing cherub, and I appointed you; you were on the holy mountain of God; you walked about in the midst of stones of fire.
verses.28:15: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until wrongdoing was found in you.
verses.28:16: In the abundance of your trade your midst was filled with violence, and you sinned; so I drove you out as profane from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, overshadowing cherub, from the midst of stones of fire.
verses.28:17: Your heart grew lofty because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your radiance. I hurled you to the ground; I set you before kings so that they might gaze upon you.
verses.28:18: By the abundance of your iniquities, in the wrongdoing of your trade, you defiled your sanctuaries. So I brought fire out from your midst; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes upon the earth before the eyes of all who see you.
verses.28:19: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever.'"
verses.28:20: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.28:21: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
verses.28:22: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments in her and show Myself holy in her.
verses.28:23: And I will send pestilence into her and blood into her streets, and the pierced will fall in her midst by the sword against her on every side; and they will know that I am the LORD.
verses.28:24: And for the house of Israel there will no longer be a stinging brier or a painful thorn from any of those around them who treat them with contempt; and they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
verses.28:25: This is what the Lord GOD says: "When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they were scattered, and show Myself holy in them before the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
verses.28:26: And they will dwell on it securely; they will build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell securely when I execute judgments upon all those around them who treat them with contempt; and they will know that I am the LORD their God."
verses.29:1: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.29:2: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all of Egypt.
verses.29:3: Speak and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster crouching in the midst of his Nile streams, who has said, "Mine is my Nile, and I made it for myself."
verses.29:4: I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your Nile streams cling to your scales, and I will bring you up from the midst of your Nile streams along with all the fish of your Nile streams that cling to your scales.
verses.29:5: I will cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your Nile streams. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered and will not be collected. To the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the sky I have given you for food.
verses.29:6: Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a reed staff to the house of Israel.
verses.29:7: When they grasped you with the hand, you splintered and tore open all their shoulders; and when they leaned on you, you broke and brought all their loins to a standstill.
verses.29:8: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will cut off from you man and beast.
verses.29:9: And the land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin, and they will know that I am the LORD. Because he said, "The Nile is mine, and I made it,"
verses.29:10: therefore, look, I am against you and against your Nile streams, and I will make the land of Egypt into ruins of waste and desolation, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
verses.29:11: No foot of man will pass through it, and no foot of beast will pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.29:12: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated lands, and its cities, in the midst of ruined cities, will be a desolation for forty years. And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands.
verses.29:13: For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
verses.29:14: And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
verses.29:15: It will be the lowliest of the kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. And I will diminish them so that they do not rule over the nations.
verses.29:16: And it will never again be a source of trust for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turn after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
verses.29:17: Now in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.29:18: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army perform a great labor against Tyre; every head was made bald and every shoulder was rubbed bare, yet there were no wages for him or for his army from Tyre for the labor that he performed against it.
verses.29:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth and seize its spoil and plunder its booty, and it will be wages for his army.
verses.29:20: As his wages, for which he labored against it, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they acted for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.29:21: On that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and to you I will grant an opening of the mouth in their midst; and they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.30:1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.30:2: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, "Alas for the day!"
verses.30:3: For a day is near, indeed a day of the LORD is near; a day of clouds, it will be a time for the nations.
verses.30:4: A sword will come upon Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush when the mortally wounded fall in Egypt; and they will carry away its wealth, and its foundations will be torn down.
verses.30:5: Cush, Put, Lud, all the mixed peoples, Cub, and the sons of the land of the covenant will fall with them by the sword.
verses.30:6: This is what the LORD says: Those who uphold Egypt will fall, and the pride of its strength will come down; from Migdol to Syene they will fall in it by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.30:7: And they will be desolated in the midst of desolated lands, and its cities will be in the midst of ruined cities.
verses.30:8: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all its helpers are broken.
verses.30:9: On that day messengers will go out from before Me in ships to terrify secure Cush, and anguish will be upon them on the day of Egypt; for look, it is coming!
verses.30:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the multitude of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.30:11: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought to destroy the land; and they will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the mortally wounded.
verses.30:12: And I will make the Nile streams dry ground, and sell the land into the hand of wicked men; and I will make the land and its fullness desolate by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken.
verses.30:13: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the worthless gods from Noph; and there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.30:14: I will make Pathros desolate, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgments on No.
verses.30:15: I will pour out My fury on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.30:16: I will set fire to Egypt; Sin will writhe in great anguish, No will be breached open, and Noph will have adversaries by day.
verses.30:17: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
verses.30:18: And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I break there the yoke bars of Egypt, and the pride of its strength will come to an end in it; as for it, a cloud will cover it, and its daughters will go into captivity.
verses.30:19: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.30:20: Now in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.30:21: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and look, it has not been bound up to apply remedies, or to put on a bandage to bind it up so that it might grow strong to grasp the sword.
verses.30:22: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, both the strong one and the broken one, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
verses.30:23: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands.
verses.30:24: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him with the groans of a mortally wounded man.
verses.30:25: I will uphold the arms of the king of Babylon, while the arms of Pharaoh will fall. And they will know that I am the LORD when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
verses.30:26: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands; and they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.31:1: Now in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.31:2: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: 'Whom are you like in your greatness?
verses.31:3: Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches and forest shade, and tall in stature, and its top was among the dense boughs.
verses.31:4: Waters made it grow; the deep made it tall, with its rivers flowing around its planting place, and it sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
verses.31:5: Therefore its height towered above all the trees of the field; its boughs multiplied and its branches grew long because of abundant waters as it sent them forth.
verses.31:6: In its boughs all the birds of the sky made their nests, and under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth, and in its shade all the great nations dwelt.
verses.31:7: And it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its root reached to abundant waters.
verses.31:8: The cedars in the garden of God could not overshadow it; the cypresses did not compare to its boughs, and the plane trees were not like its branches; no tree in the garden of God resembled it in its beauty.
verses.31:9: I made it beautiful with its abundance of limbs, and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
verses.31:10: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you towered in height, and it set its top among the dense boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
verses.31:11: I will give it into the hand of a mighty ruler of nations; he will surely deal with it. According to its wickedness I have driven it out.
verses.31:12: Foreigners, the most ruthless of nations, cut it down and abandoned it. Upon the mountains and in all the valleys its limbs fell, and its branches were broken in all the ravines of the earth; and all the peoples of the earth went down from its shade and abandoned it.
verses.31:13: Upon its fallen trunk all the birds of the sky dwell, and upon its branches are all the beasts of the field,
verses.31:14: so that none of the trees by the waters may tower in their height or set their top among the dense boughs, nor may their mighty ones, all those that drink water, stand up in their height; for all of them have been given over to death, to the earth below, in the midst of the sons of men, to those who go down to the pit.
verses.31:15: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day it went down to Sheol, I caused mourning; I covered the deep for it and held back its rivers, and the abundant waters were restrained. I darkened Lebanon for it, and all the trees of the field fainted for it.
verses.31:16: At the sound of its downfall I made nations quake, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all those that drink water, were comforted in the earth below.
verses.31:17: They also went down with it to Sheol, to those killed by the sword, and those who were its arm, who dwelt in its shade in the midst of the nations.
verses.31:18: Whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie, with those killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.32:1: It happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.32:2: "Son of man, raise a lament over Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him, 'Young lion of the nations, you are undone! You were like a monster in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, muddied the waters with your feet, and trampled their rivers.
verses.32:3: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will spread My net over you with an assembly of many peoples, and they will bring you up in My dragnet.
verses.32:4: I will leave you on the land; on the open field I will hurl you. I will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you, and I will satisfy the wild beasts of all the earth from you.
verses.32:5: I will place your flesh upon the mountains and fill the valleys with your towering bulk.
verses.32:6: I will drench the land with your outflow, with your blood, up to the mountains, and the streambeds will be filled with you.
verses.32:7: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not shine its light.
verses.32:8: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will set darkness over your land, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.32:9: I will also trouble the heart of many peoples when I bring your downfall among the nations, to lands that you have not known.
verses.32:10: I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder in horror over you when I brandish My sword before their faces; they will tremble every moment, each man for his own life, on the day of your fall.
verses.32:11: For this is what the Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come upon you.
verses.32:12: By the swords of mighty warriors I will cause your multitude to fall, all of them the most ruthless of the nations; they will ravage the pride of Egypt, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
verses.32:13: I will also wipe out all her livestock from beside many waters; no human foot will muddy them anymore, nor will the hooves of livestock muddy them.
verses.32:14: Then I will cause their waters to settle and make their rivers run like oil, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.32:15: When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is made desolate of its fullness, when I strike down all who dwell in it, then they will know that I am the LORD.'
verses.32:16: This is a lament, and they will chant it; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and over all her multitude they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.32:17: It happened in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.32:18: "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt and bring it down, both her and the daughters of mighty nations, to the land below, with those who go down to the pit.
verses.32:20: In the midst of those killed by the sword they will fall. She is given over to the sword; drag her away and all her multitudes!
verses.32:21: The leaders of the mighty warriors will speak to him from the midst of Sheol, together with his helpers: 'They have gone down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword.'
verses.32:22: Assyria is there and all her assembly; her graves are all around her. All of them are killed, those who fell by the sword,
verses.32:23: whose graves are set in the recesses of the pit, and her assembly is around her grave; all of them are killed, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
verses.32:24: Elam is there and all her multitude around her grave; all of them are killed, those who fell by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the land below, who spread their terror in the land of the living and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
verses.32:25: In the midst of those killed they have set a bed for her with all her multitude, with her graves all around it; all of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword, for their terror was spread in the land of the living, and they bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit; it is placed in the midst of those killed.
verses.32:26: Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude are there, with their graves all around them; all of them are uncircumcised, pierced by the sword, for they spread their terror in the land of the living.
verses.32:27: And they do not lie with the mighty warriors who fell from among the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war and placed their swords under their heads, while their iniquities were upon their bones, for the terror of mighty warriors was in the land of the living.
verses.32:28: And as for you, in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken, and you will lie with those killed by the sword.
verses.32:29: Edom is there, her kings and all her princes, who for all their might were placed with those killed by the sword; they lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit.
verses.32:30: The rulers of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who went down with those killed, put to shame despite the terror of their might; they lay down uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
verses.32:31: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army, killed by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.32:32: For I have spread My terror in the land of the living; yet he will be laid down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.33:1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.33:2: "Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them, 'When I bring a sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among their number and appoint him for themselves as a watchman,
verses.33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, and blows the trumpet and warns the people,
verses.33:4: then if anyone hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, and a sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
verses.33:5: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning; his blood will be upon himself. Yet if he had taken warning, he would have rescued his life.
verses.33:6: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, so that the people are not warned, and a sword comes and takes a person from among them, that person is taken away in his iniquity, yet his blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.'
verses.33:7: Now as for you, son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; whenever you hear a word from My mouth, you must warn them from Me.
verses.33:8: When I say to the wicked, 'Wicked man, you will surely die,' and you do not speak to warn the wicked away from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet his blood I will demand from your hand.
verses.33:9: But if you warn a wicked man away from his way to turn from it, and he does not turn from his way, he will die in his iniquity, while you have delivered your own life.
verses.33:10: Now as for you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'This is what you have spoken, saying: Surely our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are wasting away; how then can we live?'
verses.33:11: Say to them, 'As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I do not delight in the death of the wicked, but rather in the wicked turning from his way and living. Turn, turn from your evil ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?'
verses.33:12: And you, son of man, say to the sons of your people, 'The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him on the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not stumble over it on the day he turns from his wickedness; nor will a righteous man be able to live by his righteousness on the day he sins.
verses.33:13: When I say to the righteous that he will surely live, and he trusts in his righteousness and commits injustice, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; rather, for the injustice that he has committed, by it he will die.
verses.33:14: And when I say to the wicked, You will surely die, yet he turns from his sin and practices justice and righteousness,
verses.33:15: if the wicked restores a pledge, repays what was taken by robbery, and walks in the statutes of life so as not to commit injustice, he will surely live; he will not die.
verses.33:16: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him; he has practiced justice and righteousness; he will surely live.'
verses.33:17: Yet the sons of your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair,' when as for them, it is their own way that is not fair.
verses.33:18: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, he will die because of it.
verses.33:19: And when a wicked man turns from his wickedness and practices justice and righteousness, on account of them he will live.
verses.33:20: Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' I will judge you, each man according to his ways, house of Israel."
verses.33:21: It happened in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month, on the fifth of the month, that the fugitive from Jerusalem came to me, saying, "The city has been struck down!"
verses.33:22: Now the hand of the LORD had been upon me in the evening before the fugitive arrived, and He opened my mouth by the time he came to me in the morning; so my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
verses.33:23: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.33:24: "Son of man, the inhabitants of these ruins on the soil of Israel are speaking, saying, 'Abraham was one man, yet he possessed the land; but we are many, so to us the land has been given as a possession.'
verses.33:25: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You eat with the blood, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood; should you then possess the land?'
verses.33:27: Say this to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: As I live, surely those who are in the ruins will fall by the sword, whoever is in the open field I will give to the wild beasts to devour him, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die by pestilence.
verses.33:28: I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end; the mountains of Israel will be desolate, with no one passing through.
verses.33:29: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I make the land a desolation and a waste because of all their abominations that they have committed.'
verses.33:30: Now as for you, son of man, the sons of your people are talking about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses; one speaks to another, each man to his brother, saying, 'Come now and hear what the word is that goes forth from the LORD.'
verses.33:31: They come to you as people come, and My people sit before you, and hear your words, yet they do not do them; for with their mouth they make a show of passionate love, while their heart goes after their dishonest gain.
verses.33:32: And look, you are to them like a song of passionate love, of one with a beautiful voice who plays well on an instrument; so they hear your words, yet they do not do them.
verses.33:33: And when it comes to pass—look, it is coming—then they will know that a prophet has been in their midst."
verses.34:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.34:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them, to the shepherds, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who have been tending themselves! Should not the shepherds tend the flock?
verses.34:3: You eat the fat and wear the wool; you slaughter the fattened ones, yet you do not tend the flock.
verses.34:4: You have not strengthened the weak, you have not healed the sick, you have not bandaged the broken, you have not brought back the strayed, and you have not sought the lost; rather, you have ruled over them with force and with harshness.
verses.34:5: So they were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and they became food for every wild animal of the field, and they were scattered.
verses.34:6: My flock wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Over the whole face of the earth My flock was scattered, and there was no one searching and no one seeking.
verses.34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.34:8: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely because My flock became plunder, and My flock became food for every wild animal of the field because there was no shepherd, and My shepherds did not search for My flock, but the shepherds tended themselves and did not tend My flock,
verses.34:9: therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.34:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand My flock from their hand and stop them from tending the flock, so the shepherds will no longer tend themselves. I will rescue My flock from their mouth, and they will not be food for them.
verses.34:11: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I Myself will search for My flock and look after them.
verses.34:12: Just as a shepherd looks after his flock on the day he is among his scattered sheep, so I will look after My flock; and I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of cloud and dense darkness.
verses.34:13: I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will tend them on the mountains of Israel, in the streambeds, and in all the dwelling places of the land.
verses.34:14: In good pasture I will tend them, and their grazing ground will be on the mountain heights of Israel. There they will lie down in a good grazing ground, and they will graze on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.34:15: I Myself will tend My flock, and I Myself will make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.34:16: I will seek the lost, I will bring back the strayed, I will bandage the broken, and I will strengthen the sick; but the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will tend them with justice.
verses.34:17: And as for you, My flock, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to judge between sheep and sheep—the rams and the male goats.
verses.34:18: Is it too little for you that you graze on the good pasture, yet trample the rest of your pastures with your feet? And that you drink clear water, yet muddy what remains with your feet?
verses.34:19: And My flock must graze on what your feet have trampled and drink what your feet have muddied.
verses.34:20: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says to them: Look, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.34:21: Because you shove with flank and shoulder and butt all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
verses.34:22: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be plunder; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verses.34:23: And I will raise up over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will tend them. He will tend them, and he will be their shepherd.
verses.34:24: And I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
verses.34:25: I will make a covenant of peace with them and banish dangerous animals from the land, so that they will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
verses.34:26: I will make them and the surroundings of My hill a blessing, and I will send down the rain in its season; they will be rains of blessing.
verses.34:27: The trees of the field will yield their fruit, and the earth will yield its produce, and they will be secure on their own land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
verses.34:28: They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the wild animals of the land will not devour them; they will dwell securely, with no one to frighten them.
verses.34:29: I will raise up for them a planting of renown, and they will no longer be swept away by famine in the land, nor bear the disgrace of the nations any longer.
verses.34:30: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they are My people, the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.34:31: And as for you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are human beings; I am your God, declares the Lord GOD.'"
verses.35:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.35:2: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
verses.35:3: and say to it, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir; I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolation and a devastation.
verses.35:4: I will lay your cities in ruins, and you yourself will become a desolation; then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.35:5: Because you have held a perpetual enmity and handed the sons of Israel over to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of final punishment,
verses.35:6: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will appoint you for bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you; since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.
verses.35:7: I will make Mount Seir a wasteland and a desolation, and I will cut off from it anyone who passes through and returns.
verses.35:8: I will fill its mountains with its dead; your hills, your valleys, and all your streambeds—those killed by the sword will fall in them.
verses.35:9: I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities will not be restored. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.35:10: Because you have said, "The two nations and the two lands will be mine, and we will possess it," though the LORD was there,
verses.35:11: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will act according to your anger and according to your envy, with which you acted out of your hatred against them; and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.35:12: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults that you spoke against the mountains of Israel, saying, "They have become desolate; they have been given to us for food."
verses.35:13: You spoke arrogantly against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me; I Myself have heard it.
verses.35:14: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.
verses.35:15: Just as you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it became desolate, so I will do to you. You will become a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.36:1: Now you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, "Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.36:2: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said about you, 'Aha! Even the ancient heights have become a possession for us,'"
verses.36:3: therefore prophesy and say, "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because, yes because, they have made you desolate and crushed you from every side, so that you became a possession for the remnant of the nations, and you were taken up on the lips of talkers and in the slander of the people,
verses.36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, and to the desolate ruins and to the abandoned cities, which have become plunder and derision for the remnant of the nations that are all around—
verses.36:5: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the remnant of the nations and against all Edom, who assigned My land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted gladness and with scorn of soul, so that its open pastureland would become plunder."
verses.36:6: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, "This is what the Lord GOD says: See, in My jealousy and in My wrath I have spoken, because you have borne the disgrace of the nations.
verses.36:7: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I Myself have lifted up My hand: surely the nations that are all around you—they themselves will bear their own disgrace.
verses.36:8: But you, mountains of Israel, will put forth your branches and bear your fruit for My people Israel, for they are near to coming.
verses.36:9: For look, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
verses.36:10: And I will multiply people upon you, the whole house of Israel, all of it; and the cities will be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.36:11: And I will multiply people and livestock upon you, and they will grow numerous and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited as in your former times, and I will do better for you than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
verses.36:12: And I will cause people—My people Israel—to walk upon you, and they will possess you, and you will become an inheritance for them, and you will never again bereave them of children."
verses.36:13: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because they say to you, 'You are a devourer of people, and you have been one who bereaves your nations,'
verses.36:14: therefore you will no longer devour people, and you will no longer bereave your nations, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.36:15: And I will no longer let you hear the disgrace of the nations, and you will no longer bear the reproach of peoples, and you will no longer cause your nations to stumble, declares the Lord GOD."
verses.36:16: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.36:17: "Son of man, when the house of Israel were living on their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their deeds; their way before Me was like the impurity of menstrual separation.
verses.36:18: So I poured out My wrath upon them for the blood that they had poured out upon the land, and because they defiled it with their idols.
verses.36:19: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the lands; according to their way and according to their deeds I judged them.
verses.36:20: And when they came to the nations where they came, they profaned My holy name, in that it was said about them, 'These are the people of the LORD, yet they have gone out from His land.'
verses.36:21: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they had come.
verses.36:22: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I am acting, house of Israel, but rather for My holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you came.
verses.36:23: And I will sanctify My great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show Myself holy through you before their eyes.
verses.36:24: And I will take you from the nations, and I will gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you to your own soil.
verses.36:25: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will become clean; from all your impurities and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
verses.36:26: And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will place inside you; I will take away the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.36:27: And My Spirit I will place inside you, and I will make you walk in My statutes, and you will keep My ordinances and do them.
verses.36:28: And you will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; you will be a people to Me, and I Myself will be God to you.
verses.36:29: And I will deliver you from all your impurities; and I will call to the grain and multiply it, and I will not lay famine upon you.
verses.36:30: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will never again receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.36:31: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight because of your iniquities and because of your abominations.
verses.36:32: It is not for your sake that I am acting, declares the Lord GOD—let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced because of your ways, house of Israel.'"
verses.36:33: This is what the Lord GOD says: "On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.36:34: And the desolate land will be cultivated, instead of being a desolation in the sight of everyone who passed by.
verses.36:35: And they will say, 'This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden, and the ruined, desolate, and demolished cities are fortified and inhabited.'
verses.36:36: Then the nations that remain all around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt the demolished places, have planted the desolate place; I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it."
verses.36:37: This is what the Lord GOD says: "This also I will let Myself be inquired of by the house of Israel to do for them: I will multiply them with people like a flock.
verses.36:38: Like the flock for holy offerings, like the flock of Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so the ruined cities will be full of flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD."
verses.37:1: The hand of the LORD came upon me, and He led me out by the Spirit of the LORD and placed me in the midst of the valley, and it was full of bones.
verses.37:2: And He caused me to pass among them round and round, and look, there were very many on the surface of the valley, and look, they were very dry.
verses.37:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, will these bones live?" And I said, "Lord GOD, You know."
verses.37:4: Then He said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.37:5: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: Look, I am about to bring breath into you, and you will live.
verses.37:6: And I will lay sinews upon you, and bring up flesh upon you, and spread skin over you, and put breath in you, and you will live; and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
verses.37:7: So I prophesied just as I had been commanded; and as I was prophesying, there was a sound, and look, a rattling, and the bones drew near, bone to its bone.
verses.37:8: And I looked, and see, sinews were on them, and flesh had come up, and skin had spread over them on top, yet there was no breath in them.
verses.37:9: Then He said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: From the four winds come, breath, and breathe into these who were killed, so that they may live.'"
verses.37:10: So I prophesied just as He commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they came to life and stood on their feet, a very, very great army.
verses.37:11: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they say, 'Our bones have dried up, and our hope has perished; we are completely cut off.'
verses.37:12: Therefore prophesy and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to open your graves and bring you up out of your graves, My people, and I will bring you to the land of Israel.
verses.37:13: And you will know that I am the LORD when I open your graves and when I bring you up out of your graves, My people.
verses.37:14: And I will place My Spirit in you, and you will live, and I will settle you upon your own soil. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it, declares the LORD.'"
verses.37:15: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
