native_verses.16:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.16:2: "Son of man, make Jerusalem know her abominations,
native_verses.16:3: and say, This is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your origins and your birth are from the land of the Canaanite; your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
native_verses.16:4: And as for your birth, on the day you were born, your umbilical cord was not cut, you were not washed in water for cleansing, you were not rubbed with salt at all, and you were not swaddled at all.
native_verses.16:5: No eye took pity on you to do any one of these things for you, to show you compassion; instead, you were thrown out onto the open field in loathing of your life on the day you were born.
native_verses.16:6: Then I passed by you and saw you thrashing in your blood, and I said to you, 'In your blood, live!' And I said to you, 'In your blood, live!'
native_verses.16:7: I made you a myriad, like the growth of the field; you increased and grew up and came into the finest of ornaments. Your breasts became firm and your hair grew out, though you were naked and bare.
native_verses.16:8: Then I passed by you and saw you, and look, your time was the time for love. So I spread the edge of My garment over you and covered your nakedness; I swore an oath to you and entered a covenant with you, declares the Lord GOD, and you became Mine.
native_verses.16:9: Then I washed you in water, rinsed your blood off you, and anointed you with oil.
native_verses.16:10: I dressed you in embroidered cloth and put fine leather sandals on you; I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
native_verses.16:11: I adorned you with jewelry, and I placed bracelets on your wrists and a chain around your neck.
native_verses.16:12: I also set a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears, and a crown of splendor on your head.
native_verses.16:13: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your attire was fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate choice flour, honey, and oil, and you became exceedingly beautiful and rose to royalty.
native_verses.16:14: Your renown went out among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was complete through My majesty that I had placed on you, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.16:15: Yet you trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your renown, and you poured out your acts of prostitution on every passerby; his it became.
native_verses.16:16: You took some of your garments, made for yourself multicolored high places, and prostituted yourself on them; such things have never come about and never will be.
native_verses.16:17: You also took your jewels of splendor, of My gold and My silver that I had given you, and made for yourself male images and prostituted yourself with them.
native_verses.16:18: You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you placed My oil and My incense before them.
native_verses.16:19: And My bread that I gave you, choice flour, oil, and honey that I fed you, you set before them as a soothing fragrance; and so it was, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.16:20: You took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne to Me, and you sacrificed them to them to be devoured. Were your acts of prostitution too small a matter,
native_verses.16:21: that you slaughtered My children and gave them up by causing them to pass over to them?
native_verses.16:22: And with all your abominations and your acts of prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, when you were thrashing in your blood.
native_verses.16:23: And it happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you, declares the Lord GOD—
native_verses.16:24: that you built yourself a vaulted mound and made yourself a lofty platform in every open square.
native_verses.16:25: At the head of every road you built your lofty platform, made your beauty an abomination, spread your legs to every passerby, and multiplied your acts of prostitution.
native_verses.16:26: You also prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, large of flesh, and you multiplied your prostitution to provoke Me to anger.
native_verses.16:27: So look, I stretched out My hand against you, reduced your ration, and gave you over to the appetite of those who hated you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd way.
native_verses.16:28: Then you prostituted yourself with the sons of Assyria because you were unsatisfied; you prostituted yourself with them, and even then you were not satisfied.
native_verses.16:29: And you multiplied your prostitution toward the land of commerce, to Chaldea, and even with this you were not satisfied.
native_verses.16:30: How feeble is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, when you do all these things, the deeds of a domineering prostitute!
native_verses.16:31: When you built your vaulted mound at the head of every road and made your lofty platform in every open square, you were not like a prostitute, for you scoffed at payment.
native_verses.16:32: Adulterous wife! In place of her husband, she takes strangers!
native_verses.16:33: To all prostitutes they give a gift, yet you gave your gifts to all your lovers and bribed them to come to you from all around for your acts of prostitution.
native_verses.16:34: So in you it was the reverse of other women in your acts of prostitution: no one went after you for prostitution, and because you gave payment while no payment was given to you, you became the reverse.
native_verses.16:35: Therefore, prostitute, hear the word of the LORD.
native_verses.16:36: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because your lust was poured out and your nakedness was exposed in your acts of prostitution with your lovers and with all the idols of your abominations, and because of the blood of your children whom you gave to them,
native_verses.16:37: therefore look, I am about to gather all your lovers to whom you were pleasing, all whom you loved along with all whom you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and expose your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.
native_verses.16:38: I will judge you with the judgments for women who commit adultery and who shed blood, and I will give you the bloodshed of fury and jealousy.
native_verses.16:39: I will deliver you into their hand, and they will tear down your vaulted mound and demolish your lofty platforms; they will strip you of your garments, take your jewels of splendor, and leave you naked and bare.
native_verses.16:40: They will bring up an assembly against you, stone you with stones, and hack you to pieces with their swords.
native_verses.16:41: They will burn your houses with fire and carry out judgments against you before the eyes of many women. I will cause you to cease from being a prostitute, and you will also no longer give payment.
native_verses.16:42: Then I will lay My fury to rest upon you, and My jealousy will turn away from you; I will grow quiet and will not be angry anymore.
native_verses.16:43: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but enraged Me with all these things, look, I too have brought your way upon your head, declares the Lord GOD. Did you not commit this lewdness on top of all your abominations?
native_verses.16:44: Look, everyone who speaks proverbs will speak this proverb about you, saying, 'Like mother, like daughter.'
native_verses.16:45: You are the daughter of your mother, who abhors her husband and her children, and you are the sister of your sisters, who abhorred their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father was an Amorite.
native_verses.16:46: And your older sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwells at your left; and your sister younger than you, who dwells on your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
native_verses.16:47: You did not merely walk in their ways and act according to their abominations; as if that were a very small thing, you acted more corruptly than they did in all your ways.
native_verses.16:48: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, Sodom your sister, she and her daughters, did not act as you and your daughters have acted.
native_verses.16:49: Look, this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and tranquil ease belonged to her and her daughters, yet she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
native_verses.16:50: They grew haughty and committed an abomination before Me, so I took them away when I saw it.
native_verses.16:51: And Samaria did not sin half of your sins; you multiplied your abominations more than they and made your sisters seem righteous through all your abominations that you have done.
native_verses.16:52: You too, bear your disgrace, you who have judged in favor of your sister; because of your sins in which you acted more abominably than they, they are more righteous than you. So you too, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, in making your sisters seem righteous.
native_verses.16:53: Yet I will restore their fortunes, the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and the fortunes of Samaria and her daughters, and the restoration of your own fortunes in their midst,
native_verses.16:54: so that you may bear your disgrace and be humiliated for all that you have done, in comforting them.
native_verses.16:55: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former condition, and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former condition, and you and your daughters will return to your former condition.
native_verses.16:56: Was Sodom your sister not a byword in your mouth on the day of your pride,
native_verses.16:57: before your wickedness was exposed, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Aram and all those around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you from all around?
native_verses.16:58: Your lewdness and your abominations, you yourself bear them, declares the LORD.
native_verses.16:59: For this is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you just as you have done, because you despised the oath by violating the covenant.
native_verses.16:60: Yet I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an eternal covenant for you.
native_verses.16:61: Then you will remember your ways and be humiliated when you receive your sisters, both those older than you and those younger than you; and I will give them to you as daughters, though not on account of your covenant.
native_verses.16:62: And I Myself will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,
native_verses.16:63: in order that you may remember and be ashamed, and no longer open your mouth because of your disgrace, when I make atonement for you for all that you have done, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.17:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.17:2: "Son of man, pose a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
native_verses.17:3: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: The great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of plumage with variegated colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
native_verses.17:4: He plucked off the topmost of its young shoots and brought it to a land of trade; he set it in a city of merchants.
native_verses.17:5: He also took from the seed of the land and put it in a field for sowing; he took it beside abundant waters and set it like a willow.
native_verses.17:6: And it sprouted and became a spreading vine, low in stature, so that its branches turned toward him while its roots remained under it. Thus it became a vine, produced shoots, and sent out boughs.
native_verses.17:7: Now there was another great eagle with great wings and abundant plumage. And look, this vine bent its roots toward him and sent out its branches to him, so that he might water it from the beds of its planting.
native_verses.17:8: In a good field beside abundant waters it was planted, to produce branches and bear fruit, to become a majestic vine.'
native_verses.17:9: Say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Will it prosper? Will he not tear out its roots and strip off its fruit so that it withers? All the fresh leaves of its growth will wither, and it will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by its roots.
native_verses.17:10: And look, though it is planted, will it prosper? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind strikes it? On the beds where it sprouted it will wither.'"
native_verses.17:11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.17:12: "Say now to the rebellious house, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Say, 'Look, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its officials, and brought them to himself in Babylon.
native_verses.17:13: He also took one from the royal seed and made a covenant with him, bringing him under an oath, and he took away the mighty men of the land,
native_verses.17:14: so that the kingdom would be lowly and not lift itself up, keeping his covenant in order that it might stand.
native_verses.17:15: But he rebelled against him by sending his messengers to Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one who does these things escape? Can he break a covenant and still escape?
native_verses.17:16: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, with him in the midst of Babylon he will die.
native_verses.17:17: Nor will Pharaoh with a great army and a numerous company act for him in the war, when they cast up a siege mound and build a siege wall to cut off many lives.
native_verses.17:18: For he despised an oath by breaking a covenant, and look, he had given his hand, yet he did all these things; he will not escape.
native_verses.17:19: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: As I live, surely My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke, I will bring it upon his own head.
native_verses.17:20: I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. And I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgment with him there for his treachery by which he acted treacherously against Me.
native_verses.17:21: And all his fugitives among all his troops will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
native_verses.17:22: This is what the Lord GOD says: "I Myself will also take from the lofty top of the cedar and set it out; from the topmost of its young shoots I will pluck off a tender one, and I Myself will plant it on a high and towering mountain.
native_verses.17:23: On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it, so that it will bear branches and produce fruit and become a majestic cedar. Every bird of every wing will dwell beneath it; in the shade of its branches they will dwell.
native_verses.17:24: And all the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, have brought low the high tree and raised high the low tree, have dried up the green tree and made the dry tree blossom. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it."
native_verses.18:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.18:2: "What is it to you that you quote this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, 'Fathers eat sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge'?
native_verses.18:3: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will surely no longer have occasion to quote this proverb in Israel.
native_verses.18:4: See, all souls belong to Me; like the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son belongs to Me. The soul that sins is the one that will die.
native_verses.18:5: Now if a man is righteous and practices justice and righteousness:
native_verses.18:6: if he does not eat at the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife, and does not approach a woman in her menstrual impurity;
native_verses.18:7: if he does not oppress anyone, returns the pledge for a debt, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment;
native_verses.18:8: if he does not lend at interest or take any increase, holds back his hand from injustice, and executes true justice between one man and another;
native_verses.18:9: if he walks in My statutes and keeps My ordinances to act in truth, he is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.18:10: Now if he fathers a violent son who sheds blood and who does any one of these things to a brother,
native_verses.18:11: though he himself has done none of those things, but has even eaten at the mountains and defiled his neighbor's wife,
native_verses.18:12: has oppressed the poor and needy, has committed robberies, does not return a pledge, has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
native_verses.18:13: has lent at interest and taken increase—will he then live? He will not live! He has committed all these abominations; he will surely be put to death. His blood will be upon him.
native_verses.18:14: Now look, if he fathers a son who sees all the sins that his father committed, and he considers them and does not act like them:
native_verses.18:15: if he does not eat on the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor's wife,
native_verses.18:16: does not oppress anyone, exacts no pledge, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry, and covers the naked with a garment;
native_verses.18:17: holds back his hand from the poor, takes neither interest nor increase, carries out My ordinances, and walks in My statutes—he will not die for the iniquity of his father; he will surely live.
native_verses.18:18: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, committed robbery against a brother, and did what is not good among his people, look, he will die for his own iniquity.
native_verses.18:19: Yet you say, 'Why does the son not bear the iniquity of the father?' Because the son has practiced justice and righteousness and has kept all My statutes and carried them out, he will surely live.
native_verses.18:20: The soul that sins is the one that will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous one will be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked one will be on him.
native_verses.18:21: But if the wicked one turns back from all his sins that he has committed and keeps all My statutes and practices justice and righteousness, he will surely live; he will not die.
native_verses.18:22: None of the transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him; by the righteousness that he has practiced, he will live.
native_verses.18:23: Do I delight at all in the death of a wicked one, declares the Lord GOD, and not rather that he turn back from his ways and live?
native_verses.18:24: But when a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits injustice, doing according to all the abominations that the wicked one has committed—will he then live? None of the righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered; for his treachery that he has committed and for his sin that he has sinned, in them he will die.
native_verses.18:25: Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Hear now, house of Israel: is My way not fair? Is it not your ways that are not fair?
native_verses.18:26: When a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits injustice and dies because of them, it is for his injustice that he has committed that he will die.
native_verses.18:27: Again, when a wicked one turns away from his wickedness that he has committed and practices justice and righteousness, he himself will keep his soul alive.
native_verses.18:28: Because he considers and turns back from all his transgressions that he has committed, he will surely live; he will not die.
native_verses.18:29: Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' Are My ways not fair, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not fair?
native_verses.18:30: Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each person according to his ways, declares the Lord GOD. Turn back and turn away from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not become a stumbling block to you.
native_verses.18:31: Throw off from yourselves all the transgressions by which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! And why will you die, house of Israel?
native_verses.18:32: For I take no delight in the death of anyone who dies, declares the Lord GOD. So turn back and live!"
native_verses.19:1: "And you, raise a lamentation over the princes of Israel,
native_verses.19:2: and say, 'What a lioness was your mother! Among lions she lay down; in the midst of young lions she raised her cubs.
native_verses.19:3: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. He learned to tear prey; he devoured people.
native_verses.19:4: Then nations heard about him; in their pit he was caught, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
native_verses.19:5: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope had perished, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
native_verses.19:6: He walked about among lions; he became a young lion. He learned to tear prey; he devoured people.
native_verses.19:7: He violated their widows and laid waste their cities, and the land and its fullness became desolate at the sound of his roaring.
native_verses.19:8: Then nations set themselves against him from the provinces all around; they spread their net over him, and in their pit he was caught.
native_verses.19:9: With hooks they put him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
native_verses.19:10: Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted beside waters; she became fruitful and full of branches because of abundant waters.
native_verses.19:11: And she had strong branches for scepters of rulers; its stature grew high among the thick boughs, and it stood out in its height with the abundance of its branches.
native_verses.19:12: But she was uprooted in fury and thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit; her strong branch was broken off and withered, and fire consumed it.
native_verses.19:13: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a land of drought and thirst.
native_verses.19:14: And fire has gone out from a branch of her shoots and consumed her fruit, so that no strong branch remains in her, no scepter for ruling.' This is a lamentation, and it has become a lamentation."
native_verses.20:1: Now it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, that men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down before me.
native_verses.20:2: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.20:3: "Son of man, speak with the elders of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Is it to inquire of Me that you are coming? As I live, I will certainly not let Myself be inquired of by you, declares the Lord GOD.'
native_verses.20:4: Will you judge them? Will you judge, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers.
native_verses.20:5: And say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I lifted My hand to the seed of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt, and I lifted My hand to them, saying, "I am the LORD your God."
native_verses.20:6: On that day I lifted My hand to them to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had scouted out for them, flowing with milk and honey; it is the splendor of all the lands.
native_verses.20:7: And I said to them, "Each of you, throw away the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am the LORD your God."
native_verses.20:8: But they rebelled against Me and were unwilling to listen to Me; not one of them threw away the detestable things of their eyes, and they did not abandon the idols of Egypt. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them, to exhaust My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
native_verses.20:9: Yet I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations in whose midst they were, before whose eyes I had made Myself known to them in bringing them out from the land of Egypt.
native_verses.20:10: So I brought them out from the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
native_verses.20:11: And I gave them My statutes and made My ordinances known to them, by which a person will live if he does them.
native_verses.20:12: I also gave them My Sabbaths to serve as a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
native_verses.20:13: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not walk in My statutes, and they rejected My ordinances, by which a person will live if he does them, and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness to bring an end to them.
native_verses.20:14: Yet I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.
native_verses.20:15: Moreover, I also lifted My hand to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given, flowing with milk and honey—it is the splendor of all the lands—
native_verses.20:16: because they rejected My ordinances, and did not walk in My statutes, and profaned My Sabbaths; for their heart was going after their idols.
native_verses.20:17: Yet My eye had pity on them so as not to destroy them, and I did not make a complete end of them in the wilderness.
native_verses.20:18: And I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their ordinances, and do not defile yourselves with their idols.
native_verses.20:19: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and do them.
native_verses.20:20: And sanctify My Sabbaths, and they will serve as a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God."
native_verses.20:21: But the children rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes, and they did not keep My ordinances to do them, by which a person will live if he does them; they profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them, to exhaust My anger against them in the wilderness.
native_verses.20:22: Yet I drew back My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.
native_verses.20:23: Moreover, I lifted My hand to them in the wilderness to scatter them among the nations and to disperse them across the lands,
native_verses.20:24: because they did not do My ordinances, and they rejected My statutes, and they profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the idols of their fathers.
native_verses.20:25: And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they would not live.
native_verses.20:26: And I defiled them through their gifts, as they caused everything that opens the womb to pass over, so that I might appall them, in order that they would know that I am the LORD.'
native_verses.20:27: Therefore, speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: In this too your fathers blasphemed Me, by committing treachery against Me.
native_verses.20:28: When I brought them into the land that I lifted My hand to give to them, they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and there they sacrificed their sacrifices, and there they gave the provocation of their offering, and there they placed their soothing fragrances, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
native_verses.20:29: Then I said to them, "What is the high place to which you are going?" So its name is called Bamah to this day.'
native_verses.20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you defiling yourselves in the way of your fathers, and prostituting yourselves after their detestable things?
native_verses.20:31: And when you lift up your gifts, in making your children pass through the fire, you are defiling yourselves with all your idols to this day. And should I let Myself be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will certainly not let Myself be inquired of by you.
native_verses.20:32: And what rises in your spirit will certainly never happen, when you say, "We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, ministering to wood and stone."
native_verses.20:33: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will reign over you.
native_verses.20:34: And I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
native_verses.20:35: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and I will contend in judgment with you there, face to face.
native_verses.20:36: Just as I contended in judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will contend in judgment with you, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.20:37: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you within the bond of the covenant.
native_verses.20:38: And I will purge from among you the rebels and those who transgress against Me; from the land of their sojourning I will bring them out, yet none of them will enter the soil of Israel. And you will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.20:39: As for you, house of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go, serve each one his idols, and afterward, if you will not listen to Me; yet My holy name you must not profane anymore with your gifts and with your idols.
native_verses.20:40: For on My holy mountain, on the mountain height of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, there all the house of Israel, all of it in the land, will serve Me. There I will accept them, and there I will require your contributions and the finest of your tribute offerings, along with all your holy gifts.
native_verses.20:41: As a soothing fragrance I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered; and I will show Myself holy among you before the eyes of the nations.
native_verses.20:42: And you will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the soil of Israel, into the land that I lifted My hand to give to your fathers.
native_verses.20:43: And there you will remember your ways and all your deeds by which you defiled yourselves, and you will feel loathing for yourselves in your own sight because of all your evils that you have done.
native_verses.20:44: And you will know that I am the LORD when I deal with you for the sake of My name, not according to your evil ways nor according to your corrupt deeds, house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.21:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.21:2: "Son of man, set your face toward the south, drop words toward the southland, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the Negev.
native_verses.21:3: And say to the forest of the Negev, 'Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you. The blazing flame will not be extinguished, and all faces from south to north will be scorched by it.
native_verses.21:4: And all flesh will see that I, the LORD, have set it ablaze; it will not be extinguished.'"
native_verses.21:5: Then I said, "Alas, Lord GOD! They are saying of me, 'Is he not a speaker of parables?'"
native_verses.21:6: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.21:7: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, drop words toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
native_verses.21:8: And say to the land of Israel, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
native_verses.21:9: Because I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore My sword will go out from its sheath against all flesh from south to north.
native_verses.21:10: And all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword out of its sheath; it will not return again.'
native_verses.21:11: As for you, son of man, groan! With breaking loins and with bitterness you shall groan before their eyes.
native_verses.21:12: And when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming! Every heart will melt, all hands will go limp, every spirit will grow faint, and all knees will run with water. Look, it is coming and it will happen, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.21:13: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.21:14: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord says!' Say, 'A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished!
native_verses.21:15: To make a slaughter it is sharpened; to have a flash of lightning it is polished. Or shall we rejoice? The scepter of My son despises every tree.
native_verses.21:16: And it was given to be polished, to be grasped in the palm; this sword is sharpened and it is polished, to give it into the hand of a killer.'
native_verses.21:17: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against My people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They have been cast to the sword along with My people; therefore strike your thigh.
native_verses.21:18: For there is a testing; and what if even the despising scepter will be no more?" declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.21:19: "And you, son of man, prophesy and strike palm against palm! Let the sword be doubled a third time, the sword of the fatally wounded; it is the sword of the great fatally wounded one, which surrounds them.
native_verses.21:20: So that hearts may melt and stumblings multiply, at all their gates I have set the threat of the sword. Ah! It is made for a flash of lightning, wrapped for slaughter.
native_verses.21:21: Gather yourself, turn right! Set yourself, turn left, wherever your face is directed!
native_verses.21:22: I also will strike My palm against My palm, and I will put My wrath to rest. I, the LORD, have spoken."
native_verses.21:23: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.21:24: "And you, son of man, lay out for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; both of them shall go out from one land. And carve a signpost; at the head of the road to a city, carve it.
native_verses.21:25: You shall lay out a road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and to Judah in fortified Jerusalem.
native_verses.21:26: For the king of Babylon stood at the fork in the road, at the head of the two roads, to practice divination; he shook the arrows, he consulted the teraphim, he looked at the liver.
native_verses.21:27: Into his right hand came the divination for Jerusalem: to set battering rams, to open the mouth for killing, to raise the voice with a battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up a siege ramp, and to build a siege wall.
native_verses.21:28: And to them it will be like a false divination in their eyes, bound as they are by solemn oaths; yet he brings iniquity to remembrance so that they may be seized.
native_verses.21:29: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have brought your iniquity to remembrance, in that your transgressions are uncovered so that your sins appear in all your deeds—because you have been brought to remembrance, you will be seized by the hand.
native_verses.21:30: And as for you, fatally wounded wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come at the time of final iniquity:
native_verses.21:31: This is what the Lord GOD says: Remove the turban and lift off the crown! This will not remain what it is: lift up what is low, and bring low what is high.
native_verses.21:32: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! This also will not be, until he comes to whom the right belongs, and I will give it to him.
native_verses.21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach.' And say, 'A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to the utmost, for a flash of lightning,
native_verses.21:34: while they see false visions for you, while they divine lies for you, to place you upon the necks of the fatally wounded wicked, whose day has come at the time of final iniquity.
native_verses.21:35: Return it to its sheath! In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
native_verses.21:36: And I will pour out My indignation upon you; with the fire of My fury I will blow upon you, and I will give you into the hand of brutish men, craftsmen of destruction.
native_verses.21:37: You will become fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land; you will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
native_verses.22:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.22:2: "And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her abominations,
native_verses.22:3: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: A city shedding blood in her midst so that her time will come, and making idols against herself to become unclean!
native_verses.22:4: By your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your idols that you have made you have become unclean; you have brought your days near and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
native_verses.22:5: Those near and those far from you will mock you, you of unclean name, full of turmoil!
native_verses.22:6: Look, the princes of Israel, each according to his might, have been in you in order to shed blood.
native_verses.22:7: Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; toward the sojourner they have dealt with oppression in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have wronged in you.
native_verses.22:8: My holy things you have despised, and My Sabbaths you have profaned.
native_verses.22:9: Men of slander have been in you in order to shed blood; upon the mountains they have eaten in you; they have committed lewdness in your midst.
native_verses.22:10: In you a father's nakedness has been uncovered; in you they have violated a woman unclean in her menstruation.
native_verses.22:11: One man has committed an abomination with his neighbor's wife, another has defiled his daughter-in-law in lewdness, and another in you has violated his sister, his father's daughter.
native_verses.22:12: In you they have taken bribes in order to shed blood; you have taken interest and increase, and you have made dishonest gain from your neighbors by oppression, and Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.22:13: And look, I have struck My palm at your dishonest gain that you have made, and at your bloodshed that has been in your midst.
native_verses.22:14: Will your heart stand firm, or will your hands remain strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
native_verses.22:15: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the lands, and I will put an end to your uncleanness from you.
native_verses.22:16: And you will be profaned in yourself before the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.22:17: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.22:18: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the midst of a furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
native_verses.22:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because all of you have become dross, therefore, look, I am gathering you into the midst of Jerusalem.
native_verses.22:20: As a gathering of silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire upon it to melt it, so I will gather you in My anger and in My wrath, and I will place you there and melt you.
native_verses.22:21: And I will collect you and blow upon you with the fire of My fury, and you will be melted in the midst of it.
native_verses.22:22: As the melting of silver in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in the midst of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you."
native_verses.22:23: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.22:24: "Son of man, say to her, 'You are a land that is not cleansed, not rained upon in the day of indignation.'
native_verses.22:25: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst; like a roaring lion tearing prey, they have devoured lives, they take treasure and precious things, and they have multiplied her widows in her midst.
native_verses.22:26: Her priests have done violence to My law and have profaned My holy things; they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, nor have they made known the difference between the unclean and the clean; they have hidden their eyes from My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned in their midst.
native_verses.22:27: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing prey, shedding blood and destroying lives in order to get dishonest gain.
native_verses.22:28: And her prophets have plastered whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, 'This is what the Lord GOD says,' when the LORD has not spoken.
native_verses.22:29: The people of the land have practiced oppression and committed robbery; they have wronged the afflicted and the needy, and they have oppressed the sojourner without justice.
native_verses.22:30: And I looked among them for a man who would build up a wall and stand in the breach before Me on behalf of the land, so that I might not destroy it, yet I did not find one.
native_verses.22:31: Therefore I have poured out My indignation upon them; with the fire of My fury I have consumed them. Their own way I have brought upon their heads, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.23:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.23:2: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
native_verses.23:3: They prostituted themselves in Egypt; in their youth they prostituted themselves. There their breasts were squeezed, and there their virgin bosoms were fondled.
native_verses.23:4: Their names were Oholah the older and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
native_verses.23:5: Oholah prostituted herself while under My authority, and she lusted for her lovers, for the Assyrians who were nearby,
native_verses.23:6: dressed in blue, governors and officials, desirable young men, all of them, horsemen riding on horses.
native_verses.23:7: She bestowed her acts of prostitution upon them, the choicest of the sons of Assyria, all of them; and with everyone for whom she lusted, she defiled herself with all their idols.
native_verses.23:8: Nor did she abandon her acts of prostitution from Egypt, for they had lain with her in her youth, and they had fondled her virgin bosoms and poured out their prostitution upon her.
native_verses.23:9: Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the sons of Assyria for whom she lusted.
native_verses.23:10: They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. So she became a byword among women, and they carried out judgments against her.
native_verses.23:11: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she corrupted her lust more than she did, and her acts of prostitution more than the prostitution of her sister.
native_verses.23:12: She lusted for the sons of Assyria, governors and officials who were nearby, dressed in full splendor, horsemen riding on horses, desirable young men, all of them.
native_verses.23:13: And I saw that she had defiled herself; there was one way for both of them.
native_verses.23:14: Yet she added to her acts of prostitution: she saw men portrayed on the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn in vermilion,
native_verses.23:15: belted with sashes around their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them having the appearance of officers—the likeness of the sons of Babylon, Chaldea being the land of their birth.
native_verses.23:16: She lusted for them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent messengers to them, to Chaldea.
native_verses.23:17: So the sons of Babylon came to her to the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution; she became defiled by them, and then her soul grew estranged from them.
native_verses.23:18: She uncovered her acts of prostitution and uncovered her nakedness; so My soul grew estranged from her, just as My soul had grown estranged from her sister.
native_verses.23:19: Yet she multiplied her acts of prostitution, recalling the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.
native_verses.23:20: And she lusted for their paramours, whose flesh was the flesh of donkeys and whose emission was the emission of horses.
native_verses.23:21: So you yearned for the lewdness of your youth, when those from Egypt fondled your bosoms on account of your youthful breasts.
native_verses.23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Look, I am stirring up your lovers against you, those from whom your soul grew estranged, and I will bring them against you from every side:
native_verses.23:23: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the sons of Assyria with them—desirable young men, governors and officials, all of them, officers and men of renown, riding on horses, all of them.
native_verses.23:24: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with an assembly of peoples. They will array large shield, small shield, and helmet against you all around; and I will place judgment before them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
native_verses.23:25: I will set My jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will remove your nose and your ears, and your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
native_verses.23:26: They will also strip you of your garments and take your ornaments of splendor.
native_verses.23:27: So I will make your lewdness cease from you, along with your prostitution from the land of Egypt; you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor will you remember Egypt anymore.'
native_verses.23:28: For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Look, I am giving you into the hand of those whom you hate, into the hand of those from whom your soul grew estranged.
native_verses.23:29: They will deal with you in hatred, take all you have labored for, and leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, along with your lewdness and your acts of prostitution.
native_verses.23:30: These things will be done to you for prostituting yourself after the nations, because you defiled yourself with their idols.
native_verses.23:31: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will place her cup into your hand.'
native_verses.23:32: This is what the Lord GOD says: 'You will drink your sister's cup, the deep and wide one; you will become an object of laughter and derision—so much does it hold.
native_verses.23:33: With drunkenness and grief you will be filled—a cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
native_verses.23:34: You will drink it and drain it dry, and you will gnaw its potsherds and tear your breasts; for I have spoken,' declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.23:35: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, you too bear your lewdness and your acts of prostitution.'"
native_verses.23:36: Then the LORD said to me, "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
native_verses.23:37: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. With their idols they have committed adultery, and even their sons whom they bore to Me they caused to pass over to them as food.
native_verses.23:38: Moreover, they did this to Me: they defiled My sanctuary on that very day, and they profaned My Sabbaths.
native_verses.23:39: When they had slaughtered their sons for their idols, they came into My sanctuary on that very day to profane it. And look, this is what they did in the midst of My house.
native_verses.23:40: Furthermore, they even sent for men coming from afar, to whom a messenger was sent, and look, they came! For them you bathed, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments.
native_verses.23:41: You sat on a stately couch with a table set before it, and you placed My incense and My oil on it.
native_verses.23:42: The sound of a carefree crowd was with her; and in addition to men from the masses of people, Sabeans were brought from the wilderness, and they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of splendor on their heads.
native_verses.23:43: Then I said concerning the one worn out by adulteries, 'Now they will practice her prostitution—even she!'
native_verses.23:44: So men went in to her, as one goes in to a prostitute; in the same way they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the women of lewdness.
native_verses.23:45: But righteous men—they will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
native_verses.23:46: For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Bring up an assembly against them, and give them over to terror and plunder.
native_verses.23:47: The assembly will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.
native_verses.23:48: So I will make lewdness cease from the land, and all the women will take warning and will not act according to your lewdness.
native_verses.23:49: They will lay your lewdness upon you, and you will bear the sins of your idols; and you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.24:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,
native_verses.24:2: "Son of man, write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has closed in against Jerusalem on this very day.
native_verses.24:3: Speak a parable to the rebellious house and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Put the pot on, put it on, and pour water into it as well.
native_verses.24:4: Gather its pieces into it, every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder; fill it with the choicest bones.
native_verses.24:5: Take the choicest of the flock, and also pile the bones beneath it; bring it to a vigorous boil, so that even its bones are cooked within it.
native_verses.24:6: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed, the pot whose corrosion is in it, and whose corrosion has not come out of it! Empty it out piece by piece; no lot has fallen upon it.
native_verses.24:7: For her blood was in her midst; she set it upon a bare rock; she did not pour it out on the ground to cover it with dust.
native_verses.24:8: To bring up wrath, to exact vengeance, I have put her blood on a bare rock, so that it would not be covered.
native_verses.24:9: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the city of bloodshed! I Myself will also make the pyre great.
native_verses.24:10: Heap up the wood, kindle the fire, cook the flesh completely, mix in the spice blend, and let the bones be charred.
native_verses.24:11: Then set it empty on its coals, so that its bronze may heat up and glow hot, and its impurity may be melted within it, and its corrosion may be consumed.
native_verses.24:12: She has exhausted efforts, yet her thick corrosion does not come out of her; into the fire with her corrosion!
native_verses.24:13: In your impurity is lewdness. Because I sought to cleanse you, yet you did not become clean, you will not be clean from your impurity anymore until I cause My wrath to rest upon you.
native_verses.24:14: I, the LORD, have spoken; it is coming, and I will act. I will not hold back, nor will I spare, nor will I relent. According to your ways and according to your deeds they will judge you, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.24:15: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.24:16: "Son of man, look, I am about to take from you the delight of your eyes with a stroke; yet you shall not mourn, and you shall not weep, nor shall your tears flow.
native_verses.24:17: Groan in silence; do not observe mourning for the dead. Wrap your turban on yourself and place your sandals on your feet; you shall not cover your upper lip, and you shall not eat the bread of men."
native_verses.24:18: So in the morning I spoke to the people, and my wife died in the evening; and in the morning I did just as I had been commanded.
native_verses.24:19: Then the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean to us, that you are doing them?"
native_verses.24:20: So I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.24:21: 'Say to the house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to profane My sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes, and the affection of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
native_verses.24:22: And you will do just as I have done: you will not cover your upper lip, and you will not eat the bread of men.
native_verses.24:23: Your turbans will stay on your heads and your sandals on your feet; you will not mourn and you will not weep, but you will waste away in your iniquities and groan to one another.
native_verses.24:24: So Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes about, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.24:25: "And as for you, son of man, will it not be on the day I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, the delight of their eyes, and the longing of their soul, along with their sons and their daughters—
native_verses.24:26: that on that day the fugitive will come to you to bring the news to your ears?
native_verses.24:27: On that day your mouth will be opened to the fugitive, and you will speak and no longer be mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."
native_verses.25:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.25:2: "Son of man, turn your face toward the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
native_verses.25:3: and say to the sons of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you said, "Aha!" over My sanctuary because it was profaned, and over the land of Israel because it became desolate, and over the house of Judah because they went into exile,
native_verses.25:4: therefore, look, I am giving you to the sons of the east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you; they themselves will eat your fruit, and they themselves will drink your milk.
native_verses.25:5: And I will turn Rabbah into a grazing ground for camels and the sons of Ammon into a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.25:6: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you clapped your hands and stamped with your foot, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,
native_verses.25:7: therefore, look, I have stretched out My hand against you, and I will hand you over as plunder to the nations; I will cut you off from the peoples and cause you to perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.25:8: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because Moab and Seir say, 'Look, the house of Judah is like all the nations,'
native_verses.25:9: therefore, look, I am about to lay open the flank of Moab from the cities, from his frontier cities, the glory of the land—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim—
native_verses.25:10: to the sons of the east along with the sons of Ammon, and I will give it as a possession, so that the sons of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
native_verses.25:11: And upon Moab I will execute judgments, and they will know that I am the LORD."
native_verses.25:12: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because Edom acted in taking vengeance against the house of Judah, and incurred grievous guilt and avenged themselves upon them,
native_verses.25:13: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast, and I will make it a ruin; from Teman as far as Dedan they will fall by the sword.
native_verses.25:14: And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will act against Edom according to My anger and according to My wrath; thus they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.25:15: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and avenged themselves with contempt of soul to bring destruction with everlasting enmity,
native_verses.25:16: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am stretching out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and cause the remnant of the seacoast to perish.
native_verses.25:17: I will execute great acts of vengeance against them with wrathful rebukes; and they will know that I am the LORD when I lay My vengeance upon them."
native_verses.26:1: Now it happened in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.26:2: "Son of man, because Tyre has said concerning Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gates of the peoples are broken; it has swung open to me; I shall be filled—she has been laid waste,'
native_verses.26:3: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, just as the sea brings up its waves.
native_verses.26:4: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will scrape her dust away from her and make her a bare rock.
native_verses.26:5: She will be a place for spreading nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD; and she will become plunder for the nations.
native_verses.26:6: Also her daughters who are in the open country will be killed by the sword, and they will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.26:7: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north, king of kings, with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly and many people.
native_verses.26:8: He will kill your daughters in the open country with the sword; he will set a siege wall against you, heap up a ramp against you, and raise up large shields against you.
native_verses.26:9: He will aim the blow of his battering ram against your walls, and he will demolish your towers with his axes.
native_verses.26:10: Because of the multitude of his horses, their dust will cover you; at the noise of horsemen, wheels, and chariots your walls will shake when he enters your gates, like the entry into a breached city.
native_verses.26:11: With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and the pillars of your strength will come down to the ground.
native_verses.26:12: They will loot your wealth and plunder your merchandise; they will tear down your walls and demolish your prized houses; and your stones, your timber, and your dust they will put in the midst of the water.
native_verses.26:13: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease, and the sound of your lyres will be heard no more.
native_verses.26:14: And I will make you a bare rock; you will be a place for spreading nets; you will not be built again, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.26:15: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: "At the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan, when slaughter takes place in your midst, will not the coastlands shake?
native_verses.26:16: Then all the princes of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be appalled over you.
native_verses.26:17: And they will raise a lament over you and say to you, 'How you have perished, inhabited from the seas, the renowned city, which was mighty on the sea, she and her inhabitants, who imposed their terror on all her inhabitants!
native_verses.26:18: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall, and the coastlands that are in the sea are dismayed at your departure.'"
native_verses.26:19: For this is what the Lord GOD says: "When I make you a city laid waste, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,
native_verses.26:20: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago, and I will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, like the ruins of long ago, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.
native_verses.26:21: I will make you a horror, and you will be no more; you will be sought, yet you will not be found again forever, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.27:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.27:2: "Now you, son of man, raise a lamentation over Tyre,
native_verses.27:3: and say to Tyre, who sits at the entrances of the sea, trader of the peoples to many coastlands, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Tyre, you have said, "I am the perfection of beauty."
native_verses.27:4: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders have perfected your beauty.
native_verses.27:5: With cypresses from Senir they built all the planks for you; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast upon you.
native_verses.27:6: With oaks from Bashan they made your oars; your deck they made of ivory in boxwood from the coastlands of Kittim.
native_verses.27:7: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt was your sail, to serve as a banner for you; blue and purple from the coastlands of Elishah was your covering.
native_verses.27:8: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were rowers for you; your wise men, Tyre, were in you—they were your helmsmen.
native_verses.27:9: The elders of Gebal and her wise men were in you, repairing your seams; all the ships of the sea and their sailors were in you to exchange your merchandise.
native_verses.27:10: Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war; they hung shield and helmet in you; they bestowed your splendor.
native_verses.27:11: The sons of Arvad and your army were upon your walls all around, and Gammadim were in your towers; they hung their shields upon your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
native_verses.27:12: Tarshish was your merchant because of the abundance of all wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they bartered for your wares.
native_verses.27:13: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech—they were your traders; with human lives and bronze vessels they bartered for your merchandise.
native_verses.27:14: From Beth-togarmah they bartered horses, riding horses, and mules for your wares.
native_verses.27:15: The sons of Dedan were your traders; many coastlands were the market of your hand; ivory tusks and ebony they brought back as your payment.
native_verses.27:16: Aram was your merchant because of the abundance of your products; with turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies they bartered for your wares.
native_verses.27:17: Judah and the land of Israel—they were your traders; with wheat of Minnith, fine meal, honey, oil, and balm they bartered for your merchandise.
native_verses.27:18: Damascus was your merchant in the abundance of your products, because of the abundance of all wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.
native_verses.27:19: Vedan and Javan from Uzal bartered for your wares; forged iron, cassia, and calamus were in your merchandise.
native_verses.27:20: Dedan was your trader in saddle blankets for riding.
native_verses.27:21: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar—they were the merchants of your hand; with lambs, rams, and male goats, in these they were your merchants.
native_verses.27:22: The traders of Sheba and Raamah—they were your traders; with the choicest of all spices, and with every precious stone and gold, they bartered for your wares.
native_verses.27:23: Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad were your traders.
native_verses.27:24: They were your traders in splendid garments, in cloaks of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of variegated fabric, bound with cords and tightly secured, in your marketplace.
native_verses.27:25: The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise; so you were filled and became very heavy in the heart of the seas.
native_verses.27:26: Those who rowed you brought you into great waters; the east wind has shattered you in the heart of the seas.
native_verses.27:27: Your wealth, your wares, your merchandise, your sailors and your helmsmen, those who repair your seams and those who exchange your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, along with all your company that is in your midst, will fall into the heart of the seas on the day of your downfall.
native_verses.27:28: At the sound of the outcry of your helmsmen, the countryside will shake.
native_verses.27:29: And all who grasp the oar, the sailors, and all the helmsmen of the sea will come down from their ships; they will stand on the land.
native_verses.27:30: And they will make their voice heard over you and cry out bitterly; they will cast dust upon their heads and roll themselves in ashes.
native_verses.27:31: And they will shave themselves bald for you and wrap themselves in sackcloth; they will weep over you in bitterness of soul with bitter lamentation.
native_verses.27:32: And in their wailing they will raise a lamentation over you and chant a lament over you: "Who is like Tyre, like one silenced in the midst of the sea?
native_verses.27:33: When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
native_verses.27:34: At the time you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company have fallen in your midst.
native_verses.27:35: All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings shudder with horror; their faces are convulsed.
native_verses.27:36: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever."'"
native_verses.28:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.28:2: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Because your heart has grown lofty and you have said, "I am a god; I sit in the seat of the gods in the heart of the seas," yet you are a man and not a god, though you set your heart like the heart of a god—
native_verses.28:3: look, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret thing is hidden from you.
native_verses.28:4: By your wisdom and your understanding you have gained wealth for yourself, and you have gained gold and silver in your treasuries.
native_verses.28:5: By the abundance of your wisdom in your trade you have multiplied your wealth, and your heart has grown lofty because of your wealth.
native_verses.28:6: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have set your heart like the heart of a god,
native_verses.28:7: therefore, look, I am bringing foreigners against you, the most ruthless of the nations; they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your radiance.
native_verses.28:8: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the death of those pierced through in the heart of the seas.
native_verses.28:9: Will you really say, "I am a god," in the presence of the one who kills you? Yet you are a man and not a god in the hand of those who pierce you.
native_verses.28:10: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.28:11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.28:12: "Son of man, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You set the seal on perfection, full of wisdom and complete in beauty.
native_verses.28:13: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering: carnelian, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise, and emerald, and gold. The craftsmanship of your tambourines and your pipes was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
native_verses.28:14: You were an anointed, overshadowing cherub, and I appointed you; you were on the holy mountain of God; you walked about in the midst of stones of fire.
native_verses.28:15: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until wrongdoing was found in you.
native_verses.28:16: In the abundance of your trade your midst was filled with violence, and you sinned; so I drove you out as profane from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, overshadowing cherub, from the midst of stones of fire.
native_verses.28:17: Your heart grew lofty because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your radiance. I hurled you to the ground; I set you before kings so that they might gaze upon you.
native_verses.28:18: By the abundance of your iniquities, in the wrongdoing of your trade, you defiled your sanctuaries. So I brought fire out from your midst; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes upon the earth before the eyes of all who see you.
native_verses.28:19: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have become a terror, and you will be no more forever.'"
native_verses.28:20: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.28:21: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
native_verses.28:22: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments in her and show Myself holy in her.
native_verses.28:23: And I will send pestilence into her and blood into her streets, and the pierced will fall in her midst by the sword against her on every side; and they will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.28:24: And for the house of Israel there will no longer be a stinging brier or a painful thorn from any of those around them who treat them with contempt; and they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.28:25: This is what the Lord GOD says: "When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they were scattered, and show Myself holy in them before the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
native_verses.28:26: And they will dwell on it securely; they will build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell securely when I execute judgments upon all those around them who treat them with contempt; and they will know that I am the LORD their God."
native_verses.29:1: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.29:2: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all of Egypt.
native_verses.29:3: Speak and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster crouching in the midst of his Nile streams, who has said, "Mine is my Nile, and I made it for myself."
native_verses.29:4: I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your Nile streams cling to your scales, and I will bring you up from the midst of your Nile streams along with all the fish of your Nile streams that cling to your scales.
native_verses.29:5: I will cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your Nile streams. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered and will not be collected. To the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the sky I have given you for food.
native_verses.29:6: Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they have been a reed staff to the house of Israel.
native_verses.29:7: When they grasped you with the hand, you splintered and tore open all their shoulders; and when they leaned on you, you broke and brought all their loins to a standstill.
native_verses.29:8: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will cut off from you man and beast.
native_verses.29:9: And the land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin, and they will know that I am the LORD. Because he said, "The Nile is mine, and I made it,"
native_verses.29:10: therefore, look, I am against you and against your Nile streams, and I will make the land of Egypt into ruins of waste and desolation, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
native_verses.29:11: No foot of man will pass through it, and no foot of beast will pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
native_verses.29:12: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated lands, and its cities, in the midst of ruined cities, will be a desolation for forty years. And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands.
native_verses.29:13: For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.
native_verses.29:14: And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
native_verses.29:15: It will be the lowliest of the kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. And I will diminish them so that they do not rule over the nations.
native_verses.29:16: And it will never again be a source of trust for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turn after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.29:17: Now in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.29:18: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army perform a great labor against Tyre; every head was made bald and every shoulder was rubbed bare, yet there were no wages for him or for his army from Tyre for the labor that he performed against it.
native_verses.29:19: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth and seize its spoil and plunder its booty, and it will be wages for his army.
native_verses.29:20: As his wages, for which he labored against it, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they acted for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.29:21: On that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and to you I will grant an opening of the mouth in their midst; and they will know that I am the LORD."
native_verses.30:1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.30:2: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, "Alas for the day!"
native_verses.30:3: For a day is near, indeed a day of the LORD is near; a day of clouds, it will be a time for the nations.
native_verses.30:4: A sword will come upon Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush when the mortally wounded fall in Egypt; and they will carry away its wealth, and its foundations will be torn down.
native_verses.30:5: Cush, Put, Lud, all the mixed peoples, Cub, and the sons of the land of the covenant will fall with them by the sword.
native_verses.30:6: This is what the LORD says: Those who uphold Egypt will fall, and the pride of its strength will come down; from Migdol to Syene they will fall in it by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.30:7: And they will be desolated in the midst of desolated lands, and its cities will be in the midst of ruined cities.
native_verses.30:8: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all its helpers are broken.
native_verses.30:9: On that day messengers will go out from before Me in ships to terrify secure Cush, and anguish will be upon them on the day of Egypt; for look, it is coming!
native_verses.30:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the multitude of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
native_verses.30:11: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought to destroy the land; and they will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the mortally wounded.
native_verses.30:12: And I will make the Nile streams dry ground, and sell the land into the hand of wicked men; and I will make the land and its fullness desolate by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken.
native_verses.30:13: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the worthless gods from Noph; and there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
native_verses.30:14: I will make Pathros desolate, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgments on No.
native_verses.30:15: I will pour out My fury on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and I will cut off the multitude of No.
native_verses.30:16: I will set fire to Egypt; Sin will writhe in great anguish, No will be breached open, and Noph will have adversaries by day.
native_verses.30:17: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
native_verses.30:18: And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I break there the yoke bars of Egypt, and the pride of its strength will come to an end in it; as for it, a cloud will cover it, and its daughters will go into captivity.
native_verses.30:19: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.30:20: Now in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.30:21: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and look, it has not been bound up to apply remedies, or to put on a bandage to bind it up so that it might grow strong to grasp the sword.
native_verses.30:22: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, both the strong one and the broken one, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
native_verses.30:23: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands.
