native_verses.30:24: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him with the groans of a mortally wounded man.
native_verses.30:25: I will uphold the arms of the king of Babylon, while the arms of Pharaoh will fall. And they will know that I am the LORD when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
native_verses.30:26: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the lands; and they will know that I am the LORD."
native_verses.31:1: Now in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.31:2: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: 'Whom are you like in your greatness?
native_verses.31:3: Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches and forest shade, and tall in stature, and its top was among the dense boughs.
native_verses.31:4: Waters made it grow; the deep made it tall, with its rivers flowing around its planting place, and it sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
native_verses.31:5: Therefore its height towered above all the trees of the field; its boughs multiplied and its branches grew long because of abundant waters as it sent them forth.
native_verses.31:6: In its boughs all the birds of the sky made their nests, and under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth, and in its shade all the great nations dwelt.
native_verses.31:7: And it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its root reached to abundant waters.
native_verses.31:8: The cedars in the garden of God could not overshadow it; the cypresses did not compare to its boughs, and the plane trees were not like its branches; no tree in the garden of God resembled it in its beauty.
native_verses.31:9: I made it beautiful with its abundance of limbs, and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
native_verses.31:10: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you towered in height, and it set its top among the dense boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
native_verses.31:11: I will give it into the hand of a mighty ruler of nations; he will surely deal with it. According to its wickedness I have driven it out.
native_verses.31:12: Foreigners, the most ruthless of nations, cut it down and abandoned it. Upon the mountains and in all the valleys its limbs fell, and its branches were broken in all the ravines of the earth; and all the peoples of the earth went down from its shade and abandoned it.
native_verses.31:13: Upon its fallen trunk all the birds of the sky dwell, and upon its branches are all the beasts of the field,
native_verses.31:14: so that none of the trees by the waters may tower in their height or set their top among the dense boughs, nor may their mighty ones, all those that drink water, stand up in their height; for all of them have been given over to death, to the earth below, in the midst of the sons of men, to those who go down to the pit.
native_verses.31:15: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day it went down to Sheol, I caused mourning; I covered the deep for it and held back its rivers, and the abundant waters were restrained. I darkened Lebanon for it, and all the trees of the field fainted for it.
native_verses.31:16: At the sound of its downfall I made nations quake, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all those that drink water, were comforted in the earth below.
native_verses.31:17: They also went down with it to Sheol, to those killed by the sword, and those who were its arm, who dwelt in its shade in the midst of the nations.
native_verses.31:18: Whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie, with those killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.32:1: It happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.32:2: "Son of man, raise a lament over Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him, 'Young lion of the nations, you are undone! You were like a monster in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, muddied the waters with your feet, and trampled their rivers.
native_verses.32:3: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will spread My net over you with an assembly of many peoples, and they will bring you up in My dragnet.
native_verses.32:4: I will leave you on the land; on the open field I will hurl you. I will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you, and I will satisfy the wild beasts of all the earth from you.
native_verses.32:5: I will place your flesh upon the mountains and fill the valleys with your towering bulk.
native_verses.32:6: I will drench the land with your outflow, with your blood, up to the mountains, and the streambeds will be filled with you.
native_verses.32:7: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not shine its light.
native_verses.32:8: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will set darkness over your land, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.32:9: I will also trouble the heart of many peoples when I bring your downfall among the nations, to lands that you have not known.
native_verses.32:10: I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder in horror over you when I brandish My sword before their faces; they will tremble every moment, each man for his own life, on the day of your fall.
native_verses.32:11: For this is what the Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come upon you.
native_verses.32:12: By the swords of mighty warriors I will cause your multitude to fall, all of them the most ruthless of the nations; they will ravage the pride of Egypt, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
native_verses.32:13: I will also wipe out all her livestock from beside many waters; no human foot will muddy them anymore, nor will the hooves of livestock muddy them.
native_verses.32:14: Then I will cause their waters to settle and make their rivers run like oil, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.32:15: When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is made desolate of its fullness, when I strike down all who dwell in it, then they will know that I am the LORD.'
native_verses.32:16: This is a lament, and they will chant it; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and over all her multitude they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.32:17: It happened in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.32:18: "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt and bring it down, both her and the daughters of mighty nations, to the land below, with those who go down to the pit.
native_verses.32:19: Whom do you surpass in loveliness? Go down and be made to lie with the uncircumcised.
native_verses.32:20: In the midst of those killed by the sword they will fall. She is given over to the sword; drag her away and all her multitudes!
native_verses.32:21: The leaders of the mighty warriors will speak to him from the midst of Sheol, together with his helpers: 'They have gone down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword.'
native_verses.32:22: Assyria is there and all her assembly; her graves are all around her. All of them are killed, those who fell by the sword,
native_verses.32:23: whose graves are set in the recesses of the pit, and her assembly is around her grave; all of them are killed, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
native_verses.32:24: Elam is there and all her multitude around her grave; all of them are killed, those who fell by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the land below, who spread their terror in the land of the living and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
native_verses.32:25: In the midst of those killed they have set a bed for her with all her multitude, with her graves all around it; all of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword, for their terror was spread in the land of the living, and they bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit; it is placed in the midst of those killed.
native_verses.32:26: Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude are there, with their graves all around them; all of them are uncircumcised, pierced by the sword, for they spread their terror in the land of the living.
native_verses.32:27: And they do not lie with the mighty warriors who fell from among the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war and placed their swords under their heads, while their iniquities were upon their bones, for the terror of mighty warriors was in the land of the living.
native_verses.32:28: And as for you, in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken, and you will lie with those killed by the sword.
native_verses.32:29: Edom is there, her kings and all her princes, who for all their might were placed with those killed by the sword; they lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit.
native_verses.32:30: The rulers of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who went down with those killed, put to shame despite the terror of their might; they lay down uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
native_verses.32:31: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army, killed by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.32:32: For I have spread My terror in the land of the living; yet he will be laid down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.33:1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.33:2: "Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them, 'When I bring a sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among their number and appoint him for themselves as a watchman,
native_verses.33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, and blows the trumpet and warns the people,
native_verses.33:4: then if anyone hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, and a sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
native_verses.33:5: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning; his blood will be upon himself. Yet if he had taken warning, he would have rescued his life.
native_verses.33:6: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, so that the people are not warned, and a sword comes and takes a person from among them, that person is taken away in his iniquity, yet his blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.'
native_verses.33:7: Now as for you, son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; whenever you hear a word from My mouth, you must warn them from Me.
native_verses.33:8: When I say to the wicked, 'Wicked man, you will surely die,' and you do not speak to warn the wicked away from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet his blood I will demand from your hand.
native_verses.33:9: But if you warn a wicked man away from his way to turn from it, and he does not turn from his way, he will die in his iniquity, while you have delivered your own life.
native_verses.33:10: Now as for you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'This is what you have spoken, saying: Surely our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are wasting away; how then can we live?'
native_verses.33:11: Say to them, 'As I live, declares the Lord GOD, I do not delight in the death of the wicked, but rather in the wicked turning from his way and living. Turn, turn from your evil ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?'
native_verses.33:12: And you, son of man, say to the sons of your people, 'The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him on the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not stumble over it on the day he turns from his wickedness; nor will a righteous man be able to live by his righteousness on the day he sins.
native_verses.33:13: When I say to the righteous that he will surely live, and he trusts in his righteousness and commits injustice, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; rather, for the injustice that he has committed, by it he will die.
native_verses.33:14: And when I say to the wicked, You will surely die, yet he turns from his sin and practices justice and righteousness,
native_verses.33:15: if the wicked restores a pledge, repays what was taken by robbery, and walks in the statutes of life so as not to commit injustice, he will surely live; he will not die.
native_verses.33:16: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him; he has practiced justice and righteousness; he will surely live.'
native_verses.33:17: Yet the sons of your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair,' when as for them, it is their own way that is not fair.
native_verses.33:18: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, he will die because of it.
native_verses.33:19: And when a wicked man turns from his wickedness and practices justice and righteousness, on account of them he will live.
native_verses.33:20: Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' I will judge you, each man according to his ways, house of Israel."
native_verses.33:21: It happened in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month, on the fifth of the month, that the fugitive from Jerusalem came to me, saying, "The city has been struck down!"
native_verses.33:22: Now the hand of the LORD had been upon me in the evening before the fugitive arrived, and He opened my mouth by the time he came to me in the morning; so my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
native_verses.33:23: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.33:24: "Son of man, the inhabitants of these ruins on the soil of Israel are speaking, saying, 'Abraham was one man, yet he possessed the land; but we are many, so to us the land has been given as a possession.'
native_verses.33:25: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: You eat with the blood, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood; should you then possess the land?'
native_verses.33:26: You have depended on your sword, you have committed abomination, and each one of you has defiled his neighbor's wife; should you then possess the land?
native_verses.33:27: Say this to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: As I live, surely those who are in the ruins will fall by the sword, whoever is in the open field I will give to the wild beasts to devour him, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die by pestilence.
native_verses.33:28: I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end; the mountains of Israel will be desolate, with no one passing through.
native_verses.33:29: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I make the land a desolation and a waste because of all their abominations that they have committed.'
native_verses.33:30: Now as for you, son of man, the sons of your people are talking about you beside the walls and in the doorways of the houses; one speaks to another, each man to his brother, saying, 'Come now and hear what the word is that goes forth from the LORD.'
native_verses.33:31: They come to you as people come, and My people sit before you, and hear your words, yet they do not do them; for with their mouth they make a show of passionate love, while their heart goes after their dishonest gain.
native_verses.33:32: And look, you are to them like a song of passionate love, of one with a beautiful voice who plays well on an instrument; so they hear your words, yet they do not do them.
native_verses.33:33: And when it comes to pass—look, it is coming—then they will know that a prophet has been in their midst."
native_verses.34:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.34:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them, to the shepherds, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who have been tending themselves! Should not the shepherds tend the flock?
native_verses.34:3: You eat the fat and wear the wool; you slaughter the fattened ones, yet you do not tend the flock.
native_verses.34:4: You have not strengthened the weak, you have not healed the sick, you have not bandaged the broken, you have not brought back the strayed, and you have not sought the lost; rather, you have ruled over them with force and with harshness.
native_verses.34:5: So they were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and they became food for every wild animal of the field, and they were scattered.
native_verses.34:6: My flock wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Over the whole face of the earth My flock was scattered, and there was no one searching and no one seeking.
native_verses.34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
native_verses.34:8: As I live, declares the Lord GOD, surely because My flock became plunder, and My flock became food for every wild animal of the field because there was no shepherd, and My shepherds did not search for My flock, but the shepherds tended themselves and did not tend My flock,
native_verses.34:9: therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
native_verses.34:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand My flock from their hand and stop them from tending the flock, so the shepherds will no longer tend themselves. I will rescue My flock from their mouth, and they will not be food for them.
native_verses.34:11: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I Myself will search for My flock and look after them.
native_verses.34:12: Just as a shepherd looks after his flock on the day he is among his scattered sheep, so I will look after My flock; and I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of cloud and dense darkness.
native_verses.34:13: I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will tend them on the mountains of Israel, in the streambeds, and in all the dwelling places of the land.
native_verses.34:14: In good pasture I will tend them, and their grazing ground will be on the mountain heights of Israel. There they will lie down in a good grazing ground, and they will graze on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
native_verses.34:15: I Myself will tend My flock, and I Myself will make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.34:16: I will seek the lost, I will bring back the strayed, I will bandage the broken, and I will strengthen the sick; but the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will tend them with justice.
native_verses.34:17: And as for you, My flock, this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to judge between sheep and sheep—the rams and the male goats.
native_verses.34:18: Is it too little for you that you graze on the good pasture, yet trample the rest of your pastures with your feet? And that you drink clear water, yet muddy what remains with your feet?
native_verses.34:19: And My flock must graze on what your feet have trampled and drink what your feet have muddied.
native_verses.34:20: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says to them: Look, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
native_verses.34:21: Because you shove with flank and shoulder and butt all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
native_verses.34:22: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be plunder; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
native_verses.34:23: And I will raise up over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will tend them. He will tend them, and he will be their shepherd.
native_verses.34:24: And I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
native_verses.34:25: I will make a covenant of peace with them and banish dangerous animals from the land, so that they will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
native_verses.34:26: I will make them and the surroundings of My hill a blessing, and I will send down the rain in its season; they will be rains of blessing.
native_verses.34:27: The trees of the field will yield their fruit, and the earth will yield its produce, and they will be secure on their own land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
native_verses.34:28: They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the wild animals of the land will not devour them; they will dwell securely, with no one to frighten them.
native_verses.34:29: I will raise up for them a planting of renown, and they will no longer be swept away by famine in the land, nor bear the disgrace of the nations any longer.
native_verses.34:30: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they are My people, the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.34:31: And as for you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are human beings; I am your God, declares the Lord GOD.'"
native_verses.35:1: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.35:2: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
native_verses.35:3: and say to it, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir; I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolation and a devastation.
native_verses.35:4: I will lay your cities in ruins, and you yourself will become a desolation; then you will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.35:5: Because you have held a perpetual enmity and handed the sons of Israel over to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of final punishment,
native_verses.35:6: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will appoint you for bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you; since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.
native_verses.35:7: I will make Mount Seir a wasteland and a desolation, and I will cut off from it anyone who passes through and returns.
native_verses.35:8: I will fill its mountains with its dead; your hills, your valleys, and all your streambeds—those killed by the sword will fall in them.
native_verses.35:9: I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities will not be restored. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.35:10: Because you have said, "The two nations and the two lands will be mine, and we will possess it," though the LORD was there,
native_verses.35:11: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will act according to your anger and according to your envy, with which you acted out of your hatred against them; and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
native_verses.35:12: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults that you spoke against the mountains of Israel, saying, "They have become desolate; they have been given to us for food."
native_verses.35:13: You spoke arrogantly against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me; I Myself have heard it.
native_verses.35:14: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.
native_verses.35:15: Just as you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it became desolate, so I will do to you. You will become a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.36:1: Now you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, "Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
native_verses.36:2: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said about you, 'Aha! Even the ancient heights have become a possession for us,'"
native_verses.36:3: therefore prophesy and say, "This is what the Lord GOD says: Because, yes because, they have made you desolate and crushed you from every side, so that you became a possession for the remnant of the nations, and you were taken up on the lips of talkers and in the slander of the people,
native_verses.36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, and to the desolate ruins and to the abandoned cities, which have become plunder and derision for the remnant of the nations that are all around—
native_verses.36:5: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the remnant of the nations and against all Edom, who assigned My land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted gladness and with scorn of soul, so that its open pastureland would become plunder."
native_verses.36:6: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, "This is what the Lord GOD says: See, in My jealousy and in My wrath I have spoken, because you have borne the disgrace of the nations.
native_verses.36:7: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I Myself have lifted up My hand: surely the nations that are all around you—they themselves will bear their own disgrace.
native_verses.36:8: But you, mountains of Israel, will put forth your branches and bear your fruit for My people Israel, for they are near to coming.
native_verses.36:9: For look, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
native_verses.36:10: And I will multiply people upon you, the whole house of Israel, all of it; and the cities will be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
native_verses.36:11: And I will multiply people and livestock upon you, and they will grow numerous and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited as in your former times, and I will do better for you than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.36:12: And I will cause people—My people Israel—to walk upon you, and they will possess you, and you will become an inheritance for them, and you will never again bereave them of children."
native_verses.36:13: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Because they say to you, 'You are a devourer of people, and you have been one who bereaves your nations,'
native_verses.36:14: therefore you will no longer devour people, and you will no longer bereave your nations, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.36:15: And I will no longer let you hear the disgrace of the nations, and you will no longer bear the reproach of peoples, and you will no longer cause your nations to stumble, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.36:16: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.36:17: "Son of man, when the house of Israel were living on their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their deeds; their way before Me was like the impurity of menstrual separation.
native_verses.36:18: So I poured out My wrath upon them for the blood that they had poured out upon the land, and because they defiled it with their idols.
native_verses.36:19: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the lands; according to their way and according to their deeds I judged them.
native_verses.36:20: And when they came to the nations where they came, they profaned My holy name, in that it was said about them, 'These are the people of the LORD, yet they have gone out from His land.'
native_verses.36:21: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they had come.
native_verses.36:22: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I am acting, house of Israel, but rather for My holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you came.
native_verses.36:23: And I will sanctify My great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show Myself holy through you before their eyes.
native_verses.36:24: And I will take you from the nations, and I will gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you to your own soil.
native_verses.36:25: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will become clean; from all your impurities and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
native_verses.36:26: And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will place inside you; I will take away the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
native_verses.36:27: And My Spirit I will place inside you, and I will make you walk in My statutes, and you will keep My ordinances and do them.
native_verses.36:28: And you will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; you will be a people to Me, and I Myself will be God to you.
native_verses.36:29: And I will deliver you from all your impurities; and I will call to the grain and multiply it, and I will not lay famine upon you.
native_verses.36:30: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will never again receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
native_verses.36:31: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight because of your iniquities and because of your abominations.
native_verses.36:32: It is not for your sake that I am acting, declares the Lord GOD—let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced because of your ways, house of Israel.'"
native_verses.36:33: This is what the Lord GOD says: "On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
native_verses.36:34: And the desolate land will be cultivated, instead of being a desolation in the sight of everyone who passed by.
native_verses.36:35: And they will say, 'This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden, and the ruined, desolate, and demolished cities are fortified and inhabited.'
native_verses.36:36: Then the nations that remain all around you will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt the demolished places, have planted the desolate place; I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it."
native_verses.36:37: This is what the Lord GOD says: "This also I will let Myself be inquired of by the house of Israel to do for them: I will multiply them with people like a flock.
native_verses.36:38: Like the flock for holy offerings, like the flock of Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so the ruined cities will be full of flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD."
native_verses.37:1: The hand of the LORD came upon me, and He led me out by the Spirit of the LORD and placed me in the midst of the valley, and it was full of bones.
native_verses.37:2: And He caused me to pass among them round and round, and look, there were very many on the surface of the valley, and look, they were very dry.
native_verses.37:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, will these bones live?" And I said, "Lord GOD, You know."
native_verses.37:4: Then He said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
native_verses.37:5: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: Look, I am about to bring breath into you, and you will live.
native_verses.37:6: And I will lay sinews upon you, and bring up flesh upon you, and spread skin over you, and put breath in you, and you will live; and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.37:7: So I prophesied just as I had been commanded; and as I was prophesying, there was a sound, and look, a rattling, and the bones drew near, bone to its bone.
native_verses.37:8: And I looked, and see, sinews were on them, and flesh had come up, and skin had spread over them on top, yet there was no breath in them.
native_verses.37:9: Then He said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: From the four winds come, breath, and breathe into these who were killed, so that they may live.'"
native_verses.37:10: So I prophesied just as He commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they came to life and stood on their feet, a very, very great army.
native_verses.37:11: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they say, 'Our bones have dried up, and our hope has perished; we are completely cut off.'
native_verses.37:12: Therefore prophesy and say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to open your graves and bring you up out of your graves, My people, and I will bring you to the land of Israel.
native_verses.37:13: And you will know that I am the LORD when I open your graves and when I bring you up out of your graves, My people.
native_verses.37:14: And I will place My Spirit in you, and you will live, and I will settle you upon your own soil. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken and have done it, declares the LORD.'"
native_verses.37:15: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.37:16: "Now you, son of man, take for yourself one stick and write on it, 'For Judah and for the sons of Israel, his companions'; then take one stick and write on it, 'For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companions.'
native_verses.37:17: And join them together, one to another, for yourself into one stick, so that they become one in your hand.
native_verses.37:18: And when the sons of your people speak to you, saying, 'Will you not tell us what these mean to you?'
native_verses.37:19: speak to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions, and I will place them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them into one stick, and they will be one in My hand.'
native_verses.37:20: And the sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.
native_verses.37:21: And speak to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to take the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from every side and bring them to their own soil.
native_verses.37:22: And I will make them into one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king will be king over all of them; and they will no longer be two nations, and they will no longer be divided into two kingdoms ever again.
native_verses.37:23: And they will no longer defile themselves with their idols, or with their detestable things, or with any of their transgressions; but I will deliver them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and I will cleanse them. And they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them.
native_verses.37:24: And My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them; and they will walk in My ordinances, and they will keep My statutes and do them.
native_verses.37:25: And they will dwell on the land that I gave to My servant Jacob, in which your fathers dwelt; and they will dwell upon it—they and their sons and the sons of their sons—forever, and David My servant will be their prince forever.
native_verses.37:26: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary in their midst forever.
native_verses.37:27: And My dwelling place will be over them; and I will be God to them, and they will be a people to Me.
native_verses.37:28: And the nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when My sanctuary is in their midst forever.'"
native_verses.38:1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
native_verses.38:2: "Son of man, direct your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
native_verses.38:3: and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
native_verses.38:4: I will turn you around and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out along with all your army—horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in splendor, a vast company with large shields and small shields, all of them wielding swords.
native_verses.38:5: With them are Persia, Cush, and Put, every one with shield and helmet.
native_verses.38:6: Gomer and all its troops, the house of Togarmah of the far reaches of the north and all its troops—many peoples are with you.
native_verses.38:7: Be ready and prepare yourself, you and all your company assembled around you, and serve as a guard for them.
native_verses.38:8: After many days you will be summoned; in the latter years you will enter a land brought back from the sword, gathered from many peoples, upon the mountains of Israel, which had been a continual ruin; yet it was brought out from the peoples, and all of them dwell securely.
native_verses.38:9: You will go up; like a storm you will come; you will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your troops, and many peoples with you.
native_verses.38:10: This is what the Lord GOD says: It will happen on that day that thoughts will rise in your heart, and you will devise an evil scheme,
native_verses.38:11: and you will say, "I will go up against a land of open villages; I will come upon those who are at rest, dwelling securely—all of them dwelling without a wall, and having neither bar nor gates,"
native_verses.38:12: to capture spoil and to seize plunder, to turn your hand against ruins now inhabited and against a people gathered from the nations, acquiring livestock and possessions, who dwell at the center of the earth.
native_verses.38:13: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all its young lions will say to you, "Have you come to capture spoil? Have you assembled your company to seize plunder, to carry off silver and gold, to take livestock and possessions, to capture great spoil?"'
native_verses.38:14: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and tell Gog, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: In that day, when My people Israel dwell securely, will you not know?
native_verses.38:15: You will come from your place, from the far reaches of the north—you and many peoples with you, every one riding on horses, a great company and a vast army.
native_verses.38:16: You will go up against My people Israel like a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I show Myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.
native_verses.38:17: This is what the Lord GOD says: Are you the one about whom I spoke in earlier days by My servants, the prophets of Israel, who prophesied for years in those days that I would bring you against them?
native_verses.38:18: It will happen on that day, the day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, that My fury will rise in My anger.
native_verses.38:19: And in My jealousy, in the fire of My wrath, I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great earthquake upon the land of Israel.
native_verses.38:20: The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the beasts of the field, every creeping thing that creeps on the ground, and every human being on the face of the ground will quake at My presence; the mountains will be torn down, the cliffs will fall, and every wall will fall to the earth.
native_verses.38:21: I will summon a sword against him throughout all My mountains, declares the Lord GOD; the sword of each man will be against his brother.
native_verses.38:22: I will enter into judgment with him by pestilence and bloodshed, and I will rain down torrential rain and hailstones, fire and sulfur, upon him and upon his troops and upon the many peoples who are with him.
native_verses.38:23: And I will show Myself great and show Myself holy, and I will make Myself known before the eyes of many nations; then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
native_verses.39:1: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
native_verses.39:2: I will turn you around and lead you forward, and I will bring you up from the far reaches of the north and bring you onto the mountains of Israel.
native_verses.39:3: I will knock your bow out of your left hand and cause your arrows to fall from your right hand.
native_verses.39:4: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the peoples who are with you; I will give you as food to birds of prey of every wing and to the beasts of the field.
native_verses.39:5: Upon the open field you will fall, for I Myself have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.39:6: And I will send fire into Magog and among those who live securely in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.
native_verses.39:7: My holy name I will make known in the midst of My people Israel, and I will no longer let My holy name be profaned; and the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
native_verses.39:8: Look, it is coming and it will be brought about, declares the Lord GOD; that is the day of which I have spoken.
native_verses.39:9: Then the inhabitants of the cities of Israel will go out and set fire to and burn the weapons—small shields and large shields, bows and arrows, hand clubs and spears—and they will make fires with them for seven years.
native_verses.39:10: They will not carry wood from the field nor cut any from the forests, for they will make fires with the weapons; and they will despoil those who despoiled them and plunder those who plundered them, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.39:11: It will happen on that day that I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea, and it will block the travelers; there they will bury Gog and all his multitude, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.
native_verses.39:12: And the house of Israel will bury them for seven months so that they may cleanse the land.
native_verses.39:13: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I am glorified, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.39:14: They will set apart men on continual duty to pass through the land, and with those passing through, men burying those left on the face of the land to cleanse it; at the end of seven months they will make a search.
native_verses.39:15: As those passing through go through the land, whenever anyone sees a human bone, he will set up a marker beside it until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
native_verses.39:16: And the name of a city will also be Hamonah. Thus they will cleanse the land.'
native_verses.39:17: And you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: Speak to the birds of every wing and to every beast of the field, 'Assemble and come; gather from all around to My sacrifice that I am sacrificing for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, and you will eat flesh and drink blood.
native_verses.39:18: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth—rams, lambs, and male goats, bulls, all of them fattened animals of Bashan.
native_verses.39:19: You will eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness, from My sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.
native_verses.39:20: You will be filled at My table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men and every man of war, declares the Lord GOD.'
native_verses.39:21: I will place My glory among the nations, and all the nations will see My judgment that I have carried out and My hand that I have put upon them.
native_verses.39:22: Then the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God from that day onward.
native_verses.39:23: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile on account of their iniquity, because they acted unfaithfully against Me; so I hid My face from them and delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, and all of them fell by the sword.
native_verses.39:24: I dealt with them according to their impurity and their transgressions, and I hid My face from them.
native_verses.39:25: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have compassion on the entire house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.
native_verses.39:26: They will bear their disgrace and all the unfaithfulness that they committed against Me, when they dwell securely on their land with no one to make them afraid.
native_verses.39:27: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, I will show Myself holy through them before the eyes of the many nations.
native_verses.39:28: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations and then gathered them to their land, and I will not leave any of them there anymore.
native_verses.39:29: And I will never again hide My face from them, since I have poured out My Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.40:1: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down, on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me there.
native_verses.40:2: In visions of God He brought me to the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain, and on it was something like the structure of a city to the south.
native_verses.40:3: He brought me there, and look, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand, and he was standing in the gate.
native_verses.40:4: The man spoke to me, "Son of man, see with your eyes and hear with your ears, and set your heart on everything that I am showing you, for you have been brought here in order that I might show it to you. Declare everything that you see to the house of Israel."
native_verses.40:5: And look, there was a wall outside the house all around, and in the man's hand was the measuring reed, six cubits, each a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the width of the structure, one reed, and the height, one reed.
native_verses.40:6: Then he came to a gate that faced toward the east and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed in width, and the other threshold, one reed in width.
native_verses.40:7: Each guardroom was one reed in length and one reed in width, and between the guardrooms was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate beside the vestibule of the gate toward the house was one reed.
native_verses.40:8: He measured the vestibule of the gate toward the house, one reed.
native_verses.40:9: Then he measured the vestibule of the gate, eight cubits, and its jambs, two cubits; and the vestibule of the gate was toward the house.
native_verses.40:10: The guardrooms of the gate toward the east were three on this side and three on that side; the three of them had one measurement, and the jambs on this side and on that side had one measurement.
native_verses.40:11: He measured the width of the entrance of the gate, ten cubits, and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
native_verses.40:12: There was a border in front of the guardrooms of one cubit, and a border of one cubit on the other side; and each guardroom was six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
native_verses.40:13: He measured the gate from the roof of one guardroom to the opposite roof, a width of twenty-five cubits, entrance opposite entrance.
native_verses.40:14: He also made the jambs sixty cubits, and up to the jamb of the court was the gate all around.
native_verses.40:15: From the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner vestibule of the gate was fifty cubits.
native_verses.40:16: There were narrowed windows for the guardrooms and for their jambs inside the gate all around, and likewise for the vestibules; windows were all around on the inside, and on each jamb were palm ornaments.
native_verses.40:17: Then he brought me into the outer court, and look, there were chambers and a pavement made for the court all around; thirty chambers were along the pavement.
native_verses.40:18: The pavement was along the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates; this was the lower pavement.
native_verses.40:19: Then he measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court on the outside, one hundred cubits, on the east and on the north.
native_verses.40:20: As for the gate of the outer court that faced toward the north, he measured its length and its width.
native_verses.40:21: Its guardrooms were three on this side and three on that side, and its jambs and its vestibule were according to the measurement of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
native_verses.40:22: Its windows, its vestibule, and its palm ornaments were according to the measurement of the gate that faced toward the east; they would go up to it by seven steps, and its vestibule was in front of them.
native_verses.40:23: There was a gate to the inner court opposite the gate on the north and on the east, and he measured from gate to gate, one hundred cubits.
native_verses.40:24: Then he led me toward the south, and look, there was a gate toward the south; and he measured its jambs and its vestibule according to these measurements.
native_verses.40:25: It and its vestibule had windows all around, like these windows; the length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
native_verses.40:26: There were seven steps going up to it, and its vestibule was in front of them; and it had palm ornaments, one on this side and one on that side, on its jambs.
native_verses.40:27: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south, and he measured from gate to gate toward the south, one hundred cubits.
native_verses.40:28: Then he brought me into the inner court by the south gate, and he measured the south gate according to these measurements.
native_verses.40:29: Its guardrooms, its jambs, and its vestibule were according to these measurements. It and its vestibule had windows all around; the length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
native_verses.40:30: And there were vestibules all around; the length was twenty-five cubits, and the width was five cubits.
native_verses.40:31: Its vestibule was toward the outer court, palm ornaments were on its jambs, and its ascent had eight steps.
native_verses.40:32: Then he brought me into the inner court toward the east, and he measured the gate according to these measurements.
native_verses.40:33: Its guardrooms, its jambs, and its vestibule were according to these measurements. It and its vestibule had windows all around; the length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
native_verses.40:34: Its vestibule was toward the outer court, palm ornaments were on its jambs on this side and on that side, and its ascent had eight steps.
native_verses.40:35: Then he brought me to the north gate, and he measured according to these measurements:
native_verses.40:36: its guardrooms, its jambs, and its vestibule; and it had windows all around. The length was fifty cubits, and the width was twenty-five cubits.
native_verses.40:37: Its jambs were toward the outer court, palm ornaments were on its jambs on this side and on that side, and its ascent had eight steps.
native_verses.40:38: There was a chamber with its entrance by the jambs of the gates; there they would rinse the burnt offering.
native_verses.40:39: In the vestibule of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.
native_verses.40:40: On the outer side, as one goes up to the entrance of the north gate, were two tables, and on the other side, belonging to the vestibule of the gate, were two tables.
native_verses.40:41: Four tables were on this side and four tables on that side, at the side of the gate, eight tables on which they would slaughter.
native_verses.40:42: There were also four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, one and a half cubits in length, one and a half cubits in width, and one cubit in height; on them they would lay the instruments with which they would slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
native_verses.40:43: And double hooks, one handbreadth long, were fastened inside all around; and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.
native_verses.40:44: Outside the inner gate were chambers for singers in the inner court, at the side of the north gate, facing toward the south; one was at the side of the east gate, facing toward the north.
native_verses.40:45: He spoke to me, "This chamber, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who keep the charge of the house;
native_verses.40:46: and the chamber that faces toward the north is for the priests who keep the charge of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi draw near to the LORD to minister to Him."
native_verses.40:47: He measured the court: a length of one hundred cubits and a width of one hundred cubits, square; and the altar was in front of the house.
native_verses.40:48: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the house and measured the jamb of the vestibule, five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side; and the width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
native_verses.40:49: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and the width was eleven cubits; and there were steps by which they would go up to it, and pillars beside the jambs, one on this side and one on that side.
native_verses.41:1: Then he brought me to the temple hall and measured the jambs, six cubits wide on one side and six cubits wide on the other side, the width of the tent.
native_verses.41:2: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the side walls of the entrance were five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other side. He also measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
native_verses.41:3: Then he went inside and measured the jamb of the entrance, two cubits, and the entrance, six cubits, and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
native_verses.41:4: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the temple hall; and he said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
native_verses.41:5: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits, and the width of the side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
native_verses.41:6: Now the side rooms were side room over side room, thirty-three times; and they extended into the wall that belonged to the house for the side rooms all around so as to be fastened, yet they were not fastened in the wall of the house.
native_verses.41:7: It broadened and wound around higher and higher for the side rooms, for the surrounding structure of the house went higher and higher all around the house; therefore the house had greater width upward, and so one went up from the lowest story to the highest by way of the middle.
native_verses.41:8: And I saw an elevation for the house all around; the foundations of the side rooms were a full reed, six cubits to the joint.
native_verses.41:9: The width of the wall belonging to the side room on the outside was five cubits, and the open space was beside the side-room structure belonging to the house.
native_verses.41:10: And between the chambers was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
native_verses.41:11: The entrance of the side room was toward the open space, one entrance toward the north and one entrance toward the south; and the width of the area of the open space was five cubits all around.
native_verses.41:12: Now the building that was in front of the separated space on the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; the wall of the building was five cubits wide all around, and its length was ninety cubits.
native_verses.41:13: Then he measured the house, a hundred cubits in length; and the separated space and the building and its walls were a hundred cubits in length.
native_verses.41:14: And the width of the front of the house and of the separated space toward the east was a hundred cubits.
native_verses.41:15: He measured the length of the building in front of the separated space that was behind it, together with its galleries on one side and on the other side, a hundred cubits. Now the inner temple hall and the porticoes of the court,
native_verses.41:16: the thresholds, the narrowed windows, and the galleries around all three of them, opposite the threshold, were paneled with wood all around, from the floor up to the windows—and the windows were covered—
native_verses.41:17: to the space above the entrance, and even to the inner house and on the outside, and on the entire wall all around, inside and outside, by measurements.
native_verses.41:18: It was made with cherubim and palm trees, a palm tree between cherub and cherub, and each cherub had two faces.
native_verses.41:19: The face of a man was toward the palm tree on one side, and the face of a young lion was toward the palm tree on the other side; it was made on the entire house all around.
native_verses.41:20: From the floor up to above the entrance, the cherubim and the palm trees were made, and on the wall of the temple hall.
native_verses.41:21: The temple hall had a square doorpost, and as for the front of the sanctuary, the appearance was the same.
native_verses.41:22: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length was two cubits; its corners belonged to it, and its length and its walls were of wood. And he spoke to me, "This is the table that is before the LORD."
native_verses.41:23: The temple hall and the sanctuary each had two doors.
native_verses.41:24: And the doors had two leaves each, two swinging leaves: two for one door and two leaves for the other.
native_verses.41:25: And on them, on the doors of the temple hall, cherubim and palm trees were made, just as they were made on the walls; and there was a wooden overhang in front of the portico on the outside.
native_verses.41:26: And there were narrowed windows and palm trees on one side and on the other side, on the side walls of the portico, as well as the side rooms of the house and the overhangs.
native_verses.42:1: Then he led me out to the outer court by the way toward the north, and he brought me to the chamber that was opposite the separated space and opposite the building toward the north.
native_verses.42:2: Facing the length of a hundred cubits was the north entrance, and the width was fifty cubits.
native_verses.42:3: Opposite the twenty cubits belonging to the inner court and opposite the pavement belonging to the outer court was gallery facing gallery in three stories.
native_verses.42:4: In front of the chambers was a walkway ten cubits wide toward the inside, a passage of one cubit, and their entrances were toward the north.
native_verses.42:5: Now the upper chambers were shorter, for galleries took space away from them more than from the lower and the middle ones of the building.
native_verses.42:6: For they were in three stories and did not have pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore the upper ones were set back more than the lower and the middle ones from the ground.
native_verses.42:7: And there was a wall outside, parallel to the chambers, toward the outer court in front of the chambers; its length was fifty cubits.
native_verses.42:8: For the length of the chambers belonging to the outer court was fifty cubits, and look, those facing the temple hall were a hundred cubits.
native_verses.42:9: And below these chambers was the entryway from the east, as one enters them from the outer court.
native_verses.42:10: In the width of the wall of the court toward the east, in front of the separated space and in front of the building, there were chambers.
native_verses.42:11: And there was a passage in front of them, like the appearance of the chambers that were toward the north, matching both their length and their width, and all their exits, according to their arrangements and their entrances.
native_verses.42:12: And corresponding to the entrances of the chambers that were toward the south was an entrance at the head of the passage, the passage in front of the matching wall toward the east, as one enters them.
native_verses.42:13: Then he said to me, "The north chambers and the south chambers that are in front of the separated space are the holy chambers, where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall place the most holy things: the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, for the place is holy.
native_verses.42:14: When the priests enter, they shall not go out from the sanctuary into the outer court, but there they shall place their garments in which they minister, for they are holy; and they shall put on other garments, and then draw near to what belongs to the people."
native_verses.42:15: Now when he had finished the measurements of the inner house, he led me out by way of the gate whose front was toward the east, and he measured it all around.
native_verses.42:16: He measured the east side with the measuring reed: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed all around.
native_verses.42:17: He measured the north side: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed all around.
native_verses.42:18: He measured the south side: five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
native_verses.42:19: He turned to the west side and measured five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
native_verses.42:20: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, five hundred in length and five hundred in width, to separate between the holy and the common.
native_verses.43:1: And he led me to the gate, a gate that faces toward the east.
native_verses.43:2: And look, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east; His voice was like the sound of many waters, and the earth grew bright from His glory.
native_verses.43:3: And it was like the appearance of the vision that I saw, like the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city, and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the Chebar River; and I fell on my face.
native_verses.43:4: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by way of the gate whose front is toward the east.
native_verses.43:5: Then a spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner courtyard; and look, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
native_verses.43:6: And I heard someone speaking to me from out of the house, while a man was standing next to me.
native_verses.43:7: And He said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel forever. And the house of Israel will no longer defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the corpses of their kings at their high places.
native_verses.43:8: When they set their threshold beside My threshold and their doorpost next to My doorpost, with the wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by their abominations that they committed, so I consumed them in My anger.
native_verses.43:9: Now let them put their prostitution and the corpses of their kings far away from Me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.
native_verses.43:10: As for you, son of man, describe the house to the house of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
native_verses.43:11: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the house, its arrangement, its exits, its entrances, all its designs, all its statutes, all its designs, and all its laws, and write it before their eyes, so that they may keep its entire design and all its statutes and do them.
native_verses.43:12: This is the law of the house: on the top of the mountain, its entire territory all around shall be most holy. Look, this is the law of the house."
native_verses.43:13: And these are the measurements of the altar in cubits—a cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth: the base is one cubit, and it is one cubit wide, and its border along its edge all around is one span; and this is the pedestal of the altar.
native_verses.43:14: And from the base on the ground to the lower ledge is two cubits, with a width of one cubit; and from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge is four cubits, with a width of one cubit.
native_verses.43:15: And the altar hearth is four cubits, and from the altar hearth upward are four horns.
native_verses.43:16: And the altar hearth is twelve cubits long by twelve cubits wide, square on its four sides.
native_verses.43:17: And the ledge is fourteen cubits long by fourteen cubits wide on its four sides, and the border around it is half a cubit, and its base is one cubit all around; and its steps face east.
native_verses.43:18: And He said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: These are the statutes of the altar on the day it is made, to offer up a burnt offering on it and to splash blood on it.
native_verses.43:19: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are from the seed of Zadok, who draw near to Me, declares the Lord GOD, to minister to Me, a bull from the herd for a sin offering.
native_verses.43:20: And you shall take some of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around; thus you shall purify it and make atonement for it.
native_verses.43:21: You shall also take the bull for the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.
native_verses.43:22: And on the second day you shall present a male goat without blemish for a sin offering, and they shall purify the altar just as they purified it with the bull.
native_verses.43:23: When you have finished purifying it, you shall present a bull from the herd without blemish and a ram from the flock without blemish.
native_verses.43:24: You shall present them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them and offer them up as a burnt offering to the LORD.
native_verses.43:25: For seven days you shall offer a male goat for a sin offering each day; and they shall offer a bull from the herd and a ram from the flock, without blemish.
native_verses.43:26: For seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and cleanse it, and so consecrate it.
native_verses.43:27: When they have completed the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall offer on the altar your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, and I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD."
native_verses.44:1: Then he brought me back by way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east, and it was shut.
native_verses.44:2: And the LORD said to me, "This gate shall remain shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it; therefore it shall remain shut.
native_verses.44:3: As for the prince, since he is the prince, he may sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by way of the porch of the gate and go out by that same way."
native_verses.44:4: Then he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the house; and I saw, and look, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD, and I fell on my face.
native_verses.44:5: And the LORD said to me, "Son of man, pay careful attention, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I am speaking to you concerning all the statutes of the house of the LORD and all its laws; and pay careful attention to the entrance of the house, along with all the exits of the sanctuary.
native_verses.44:6: And you shall say to the rebellious ones, to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Enough of all your abominations, house of Israel,
native_verses.44:7: in bringing in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary to profane My house, when you present My food, fat and blood; and they broke My covenant in addition to all your abominations.
native_verses.44:8: And you have not kept the charge of My holy things, but you appointed them as keepers of My charge in My sanctuary for yourselves.
native_verses.44:9: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter My sanctuary, not any foreigner who is in the midst of the sons of Israel.
native_verses.44:10: Rather, the Levites who went far away from Me when Israel went astray, who went astray from Me after their idols, they shall bear their iniquity.
native_verses.44:11: They shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house and ministering to the house; they shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
native_verses.44:12: Because they ministered to them before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up My hand against them, declares the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
native_verses.44:13: And they shall not approach Me to serve as priests to Me, nor approach any of My holy things, to the most holy things; but they shall bear their disgrace and their abominations that they have committed.
native_verses.44:14: Yet I will appoint them as keepers of the charge of the house, for all its service and for everything that is to be done in it.
native_verses.44:15: But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge of My sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from Me, they shall draw near to Me to minister to Me, and they shall stand before Me to present to Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.44:16: They shall enter My sanctuary, and they shall draw near to My table to minister to Me, and they shall keep My charge.
native_verses.44:17: And it shall be that when they enter the gates of the inner courtyard, they shall wear linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them while they minister at the gates of the inner courtyard and inside the house.
native_verses.44:18: Linen turbans shall be on their heads, and linen undergarments shall be on their loins; they shall not bind themselves with anything that causes sweat.
native_verses.44:19: And when they go out to the outer courtyard, to the outer courtyard to the people, they shall take off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy chambers; and they shall put on other garments, so that they will not make the people holy with their garments.
native_verses.44:20: And they shall not shave their heads, nor let their hair grow long; they shall certainly trim the hair on their heads.
native_verses.44:21: And no priest shall drink wine when entering the inner courtyard.
native_verses.44:22: And they shall not take a widow or a divorced woman for themselves as wives, but only virgins from the seed of the house of Israel, or they may take a widow who is the widow of a priest.
native_verses.44:23: And they shall teach My people to discern between the holy and the common, and make them know the distinction between the unclean and the clean.
native_verses.44:24: And in a dispute they shall stand for judgment; by My judgments they shall judge it. And they shall keep My laws and My statutes in all My appointed festivals, and they shall keep My Sabbaths holy.
native_verses.44:25: And none of them shall come near a dead person to become defiled; however, for a father or mother, for a son or daughter, for a brother, or for a sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
native_verses.44:26: And after his cleansing, they shall count seven days for him.
native_verses.44:27: And on the day he enters the holy place, into the inner courtyard, to minister in the holy place, he shall present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.44:28: And this shall be an inheritance for them: I am their inheritance; and you shall not give them a possession in Israel: I am their possession.
native_verses.44:29: The grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering—they shall eat them; and every devoted thing in Israel shall belong to them.
native_verses.44:30: And the first of all the firstfruits of every kind, and every contribution of every kind from all your contributions, shall belong to the priests; you shall also give the first of your dough to the priest, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
native_verses.44:31: The priests shall not eat anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether of bird or of animal.'"
native_verses.45:1: "And when you divide the land by lot for an inheritance, you shall set apart a contribution to the LORD, a holy portion of the land: its length shall be twenty-five thousand, and its width ten thousand; it shall be holy throughout its entire border all around.
native_verses.45:2: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred by five hundred, square all around, with fifty cubits of open space for it all around.
native_verses.45:3: From this measured area you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand and a width of ten thousand, and within it shall be the sanctuary, the most holy place.
native_verses.45:4: It shall be a holy portion of the land for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who draw near to minister to the LORD; it shall serve them as a place for houses and as a sacred site for the sanctuary.
native_verses.45:5: And twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width shall belong to the Levites, the ministers of the house, for themselves as a possession, twenty chambers.
native_verses.45:6: As the possession of the city you shall assign five thousand in width and twenty-five thousand in length, alongside the sacred contribution; it shall belong to the entire house of Israel.
native_verses.45:7: And the prince shall have land on this side and on that side of the sacred contribution and of the possession of the city, fronting the sacred contribution and fronting the possession of the city, from the western side westward and from the eastern side eastward, with a length corresponding to one of the portions, from the western border to the eastern border.
native_verses.45:8: This land shall be his as a possession in Israel; and My princes shall no longer oppress My people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes."
native_verses.45:9: This is what the Lord GOD says: "Enough for you, princes of Israel! Put away violence and devastation, and practice justice and righteousness. Lift your evictions off My people," declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.45:10: "You shall have honest scales, an honest ephah, and an honest bath.
native_verses.45:11: The ephah and the bath shall have a single standard measure, so that the bath holds a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; its standard measure shall be regulated by the homer.
native_verses.45:12: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
native_verses.45:13: This is the contribution that you shall set apart: a sixth of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give a sixth of an ephah from a homer of barley.
native_verses.45:14: And the prescribed portion of oil, by the bath of oil, shall be a tenth of a bath from each kor; ten baths are a homer, for ten baths make a homer.
native_verses.45:15: And one sheep from the flock out of every two hundred, from the watered pastures of Israel, shall be for a grain offering, a burnt offering, and peace offerings, to make atonement for them," declares the Lord GOD.
native_verses.45:16: "All the people of the land shall share in this contribution for the prince in Israel.
native_verses.45:17: And the prince shall be responsible for the burnt offerings, the grain offering, and the drink offering at the festivals, on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, at all the appointed times of the house of Israel; he himself shall prepare the sin offering, the grain offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement on behalf of the house of Israel."
native_verses.45:18: This is what the Lord GOD says: "In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without blemish and purify the sanctuary.
native_verses.45:19: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorpost of the house, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the post of the gate of the inner court.
native_verses.45:20: You shall do the same on the seventh day of the month on account of anyone who errs unintentionally or through ignorance; thus you shall make atonement for the house.
native_verses.45:21: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a festival of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
native_verses.45:22: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull as a sin offering.
native_verses.45:23: During the seven days of the festival he shall prepare as a burnt offering to the LORD seven bulls and seven rams without blemish daily for the seven days, and a male goat daily as a sin offering.
native_verses.45:24: And he shall prepare as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.
native_verses.45:25: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the festival, he shall prepare the same for the seven days: the same sin offering, burnt offering, grain offering, and oil."
native_verses.46:1: This is what the Lord GOD says: "The gate of the inner court that faces east shall remain shut during the six working days, but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
native_verses.46:2: The prince shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gate from outside and stand beside the post of the gate. Then the priests shall offer his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall bow down in worship at the threshold of the gate and go out; yet the gate shall not be shut until evening.
native_verses.46:3: The people of the land shall also bow down in worship at the entrance of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
native_verses.46:4: The burnt offering that the prince presents to the LORD on the Sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish,
native_verses.46:5: with a grain offering of an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs a grain offering of whatever his hand gives, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.
native_verses.46:6: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without blemish, and six lambs and a ram; they shall be without blemish.
